# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

515: 		var weight := 1.0 / maxf(t["dist"], 0.5)

517: 		dodge_dir += t["threat_dir"] * weight
518: 	if total_weight > 0:

309: 		# 追踪弹无法躲避，跳过

322: 			var remaining := b.max_distance - b.traveled
323: 			if t < -hero_r or t > remaining + hero_r:
324: 				continue
325: 			var closest = bpos + ldir * clamp(t, 0.0, remaining)
326: 			var min_dist := hero_pos_2d.distance_to(closest)
327: 			if min_dist < hero_r:
328: 				# 威胁方向 = 从弹道最近点指向英雄（用于计算躲避方向）
329: 				var threat_dir = closest.direction_to(hero_pos_2d) if min_dist > 0.01 else -ldir

331: 		# 定点弹（goal模式）：落点附近有AoE伤害
332: 		elif b.goal != Vector3.ZERO:
333: 			var goal_2d := Vector2(b.goal.x, b.goal.z)
334: 			var goal_dist := hero_pos_2d.distance_to(goal_2d)
335: 			var danger_r := b.damage_range if b.damage_range > 0 else hero_r
336: 			if danger_r <= 0:
337: 				danger_r = hero_r
338: 			if goal_dist < danger_r:
339: 				threats.append({"bullet": b, "threat_dir": goal_2d.direction_to(hero_pos_2d), "dist": goal_dist})
340: 	# 按距离排序，最近的威胁优先
341: 	threats.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a["dist"] < b["dist"])

Good. Key: AI is "commander" that only sets hero.move_target / manual_target / _start_casting; Hero executes movement/attack in _physics_process. AI hero is a Hero node with HeroAI child node, is_ai=true.

Also important: AI heroes not on player's screen are hidden via `hero.visible = ...` (server-side stealth for enemy AI). Also `_update_vision`.

I should check Hero.gd line ~1533 for net_driven, and the "auto chase" logic. Enough from grep.

Also check whether AI has "supervise" from BattleManager: check BattleManager around line 240-280 for human-seat heroes and 5004 for manual_target from player input. Also check the AI in `_process` order: HeroAI is a child of hero → its _process runs... child process before parent? In Godot, _process order is by tree order; children are processed before parents? Actually parent's _process is called before children's? Godot processes nodes in tree order: parent first, then children (depth-first). Hmm — for _process, Godot iterates the tree and calls _process on each node in order of children list: root, then children recursively. So parent Hero._process runs before HeroAI._process. This means AI decisions take effect next frame. Fine, not critical.

3. _decide priority order: crystal nearby minion → high defense → lane turret defense → recall at <25% → time split: <240s LaneStrategy/JungleStrategy; after 240s TeamTactics assignments (every 60s) + dragon rally.
4. After 4 min: state = PUSH/FARM and LaneStrategy.decide still runs every tick, so the micro decisions still come from LaneStrategy; TeamTactics only sets lane. Also dragon rally overrides.

# 当前 AI 架构梳理

一句话：AI 不是一套独立的战斗模拟，而是「挂在一名 Hero 节点上的指挥器」——HeroAI 每 0.5–1s 做一次决策，把结论写成 hero.move_target / hero.manual_target / _start_casting()，由 Hero 自己的 _physics_process 用与玩家完全相同的移动、普攻、技能原语执行。因此 AI 的能力上限被 Hero 的执行层限死，AI 层只负责"选什么目标、去哪、放什么技能"。

## 1. 分层结构
```
BattleManager (每帧 game_time / 每60s团队分路)
  └─ TeamTactics            4min+ 集中分路协调（4-1 / 1-3-1 / 打龙集合）
Hero (is_ai=true)
  └─ HeroAI (Node, 每英雄一个)
       ├─ AiPerception       只读世界查询（组遍历 + 距离过滤）
       ├─ AiConfig           98 个阈值常量 + 难度表（半休眠）
       ├─ 阶段策略
       │   ├─ LaneStrategy   0-4min 线上：目标优先级/防守/中路换线
       │   └─ JungleStrategy 0-4min 打野路线循环
       ├─ 战术层
       │   ├─ SkillTactics      连招/单技能评分
       │   ├─ SummonerTactics   闪现/疾跑/传送/治疗/斩杀/眩晕/净化/弱化/惩击
       │   └─ ItemActiveTactics 金身/净化/血怒/日冕/反甲/冰霜冲击/影镖
       └─ HeroBrain          英雄特判（李白/太乙/兰陵王，其余用基类）
Hero._physics_process  执行：move_target→A*寻路+避墙、manual_target→追击/普攻、_start_casting
```

## 2. 运行节奏 table

## 3. 一次 think tick 的实际顺序 (HeroAI._process)
每帧: 塔仇恨脱离 → 弹道躲避(_dodge_threats, 命中即 return)
每 tick(自然打野0.5s/线上1s): 传送 → brain.process_skill_windows → 召唤师 → 装备主动 → brain.process_special_actions → _decide → 技能升级 → 赶路位移 → 敌方AI隐身
每 5s: 买装；持续: 恢复/血包

## 4. _decide 优先级（硬编码）
P0 己方水晶15m内有敌兵 → 直接清兵
P0 高地塔/水晶被打(_handle_high_defense，50m内响应，贴塔后接手塔仇恨)
P1 本线塔被打（同上）
P2 血量<25% → RECALL_SAFE（回城读条/等泉水回血，>2000 恢复）
P3 时间分叉
  <240s: 打野→JungleStrategy.decide；线上→LaneStrategy.decide
  ≥240s: 打龙集合 > 分路策略；分路由 TeamTactics 每 60s 下发 lane
之后：目标在 10m 内 → SkillTactics 连招

## 5. 具体策略要点
- 分路按 role 分配；判定路用 x+z 符号（FARM/MID/CLASH 的几何约定）
- 线上目标优先级：最近攻击者 > 残血敌兵（避开无兵掩护的敌塔） > 敌英雄（不在己塔下）> 敌塔（有兵线）
- 防守：全队血量对比 <0.6 退到最外塔
- 中路：本路无兵无目标 → 随机换边路，30s或无目标/中塔被威胁换回
- 打野：FARM半区→线上→CLASH半区→线上 循环，野区清空推进阶段，线上单段最长30s
- 4min后 TeamTactics：经济差≥2000选敌方塔多的路，≤-3000选己方塔少的路，否则随机（中路×2）；模式 4-1/1-3-1 随机；龙存活且经济差≤3000 → 全队"打龙"（优先龙坑旁残血敌英雄，否则锁龙；原初羁绊龙跳过）
- 买装：ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(英雄名) 按合成树逐级补件，250 金币起
- 敌方 AI 战争迷雾：visible 只在 15m 内有敌英雄 / 12m 有敌兵 / 12m 有敌塔时置 true

## 6. 联机形态
host 权威；玩家席位英雄 is_ai=true 但先不挂 HeroAI；_scan_assignments 找到空闲且仍挂 HeroAI 的英雄 → queue_free(HeroAI) + net_taken=true（禁自动追击），改由远端输入直驱；掉线 _release_peer 只清输入，英雄原地待命（不会重挂 AI）。

## 7. 现状问题（技术债优先级）
1. 三套决策代码只跑一套：AiCoordinator(@deprecated)、AiStateMachine/BehaviorScorer/DecisionContext（_ready 里注释掉）、behaviors/* 四个（无任何实例化）→ 死代码 ~800 行，易误导。
2. 状态机已废：state 只是标签，4 分钟后恒为 PUSH/FARM；RETREAT/AVOID/DEFEND 从不进入 → 撤退/避战行为散落在策略内部。
3. 难度表半休眠：difficulty 恒为 GOLD，diff()/skill_hits()/score_jitter() 无调用点，prediction_frames/vision_use 无实现 → 实际只有 should_skip_think（GOLD=0）生效，等于没有难度分级。技能也从不预判（一律打目标当前位置）。
4. 连招链断：SkillTactics._execute_combo 存了 ai_combo meta，但 continue_combo() 全项目无调用 → 连招只放第一段。
5. 时间硬切：240s 前完全不看塔血量/经济，240s 后一次性切到团队分推，节奏断层。
6. 英雄特判分散：3 个 brain 在 ai/，但孙悟空筋斗云、马超/铠的 AI 普攻门又写在 Hero.gd 的 is_ai 分支 → 加英雄要同时改 ai/ + Hero.gd。
7. 感知无缓存：每个 AI 每 tick 全量遍历 entities/heroes/minions/turrets 组 + 逐实体距离；10 英雄规模下是主要 CPU 热点，可用空间网格/帧间缓存。
8. 常量单位混用：98 个常量里塔/射程用 ×0.01 换算，配合写死的坐标（水晶 ±53、泉水 ±60）→ 地图一改全废。

## 8. 如果要重整（建议顺序）
1) 删/归档死代码（先 git rm 或移到 ai/_legacy）
2) 把 Hero.gd 里的 is_ai 特判收敛到 HeroBrain
3) 接难度表（UI → AiConfig.difficulty，用 skill_hits/jitter/prediction）
4) 补 continue_combo 调用点，让连招真正成链
5) 感知加缓存（0.1s 快照给所有 AI 共享）
6) 用状态机替掉 _decide 的 if 链（或干脆删状态机字段，避免两套语义）

## 1. 分层结构
```
BattleManager (每帧 game_time / 每60s团队分路)
  └─ TeamTactics            4min+ 集中分路协调（4-1 / 1-3-1 / 打龙集合）
Hero (is_ai=true)
  └─ HeroAI (Node, 每英雄一个)
       ├─ AiPerception       只读世界查询（组遍历 + 距离过滤）
       ├─ AiConfig           98 个阈值常量 + 难度表（半休眠）
       ├─ 阶段策略
       │   ├─ LaneStrategy   0-4min 线上：目标优先级/防守/中路换线
       │   └─ JungleStrategy 0-4min 打野路线循环
       ├─ 战术层
       │   ├─ SkillTactics      连招/单技能评分
       │   ├─ SummonerTactics   闪现/疾跑/传送/治疗/斩杀/眩晕/净化/弱化/惩击
       │   └─ ItemActiveTactics 金身/净化/血怒/日冕/反甲/冰霜冲击/影镖
       └─ HeroBrain          英雄特判（李白/太乙/兰陵王，其余用基类）
Hero._physics_process  执行：move_target→A*寻路+避墙、manual_target→追击/普攻、_start_casting
```

## 2. 运行节奏 table

## 3. 一次 think tick 的实际顺序 (HeroAI._process)
每帧: 塔仇恨脱离 → 弹道躲避(_dodge_threats, 命中即 return)
每 tick(自然打野0.5s/线上1s): 传送 → brain.process_skill_windows → 召唤师 → 装备主动 → brain.process_special_actions → _decide → 技能升级 → 赶路位移 → 敌方AI隐身
每 5s: 买装；持续: 恢复/血包

## 4. _decide 优先级（硬编码）

P1 本线塔被打（同上）
P2 血量<25% → RECALL_SAFE（回城读条/等泉水回血，>2000 恢复）
P3 时间分叉
  <240s: 打野→JungleStrategy.decide；线上→LaneStrategy.decide
  ≥240s: 打龙集合 > 分路策略；分路由 TeamTactics 每 60s 下发 lane
之后：目标在 10m 内 → SkillTactics 连招

## 5. 具体策略要点
- 分路按 role 分配；判定路用 x+z 符号（FARM/MID/CLASH 的几何约定）

- 中路：本路无兵无目标 → 随机换边路，30s或无目标/中塔被威胁换回
- 打野：FARM半区→线上→CLASH半区→线上 循环，野区清空推进阶段，线上单段最长30s

5) 感知加缓存（0.1s 快照给所有 AI 共享）
6) 用状态机替掉 _decide 的 if 链（或干脆删状态机字段，避免两套语义）

# 当前 AI 架构梳理

**一句话**：AI 是一组挂载在 `Hero` 节点下的控制逻辑，并不独立进行战斗模拟：每个 AI 英雄由一个 `HeroAI` 子节点按 0.5–1 秒节拍进行决策，把结论写成 `hero.move_target`、`hero.manual_target` 和 `_start_casting()`；实际执行仍由 `Hero._physics_process` 使用与玩家完全相同的移动、普攻、技能原语完成。因此 AI 层只负责“打谁、去哪、放什么技能”，具体行为完全受执行层限制。

## 1. 分层结构

```
BattleManager（每帧 game_time；4min 后每 60s 调 TeamTactics.allocate_all → 下发 lane）
 └─ TeamTactics            宏观：4-1 分推 / 1-3-1 分推 / 集合打龙
Hero(is_ai = true)
 └─ HeroAI (Node，每英雄一个)
     ├─ AiPerception          只读世界查询：组遍历 + 距离/可见性过滤
     ├─ AiConfig              98 个阈值常量 + 难度表（实际半休眠）
     ├─ 阶段策略（0–4 分钟）
     │   ├─ LaneStrategy      线上：目标优先级 / 防守站位 / 中路换线
     │   └─ JungleStrategy    打野路线循环 + 线上镀层
     ├─ 战术层
     │   ├─ SkillTactics      连招 + 单技能评分
     │   ├─ SummonerTactics   闪现/疾跑/传送/治疗/斩杀/眩晕/净化/弱化/惩击
     │   └─ ItemActiveTactics 金身/净化/血怒/日冕/反甲/冰霜冲击/影镖
     └─ HeroBrain             英雄特判多态（李白/太乙/兰陵王，其余用基类）
Hero._physics_process → GameEntity 导航(A* + 避墙) → 普攻/施法
```

主要文件：[HeroAI.gd](ai/HeroAI.gd#L228)、[AiPerception.gd](ai/perception/AiPerception.gd#L15)、[LaneStrategy.gd](ai/LaneStrategy.gd#L349)、[JungleStrategy.gd](ai/JungleStrategy.gd#L352)、[TeamTactics.gd](ai/TeamTactics.gd#L219)、[AiConfig.gd](ai/AiConfig.gd#L1)、执行层 [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L1307)、接线 [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L4418)。

## 2. 运行节拍

| 频率 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 每帧 | 塔仇恨脱离、弹道躲避（命中即 return，抢占一切决策） |
| 0.5s（打野）/ 1s（线上） | 完整 think tick：传送 → 技能窗口 → 召唤师 → 装备主动 → 英雄特判 → `_decide` → 升级技能 → 赶路位移 → 敌方 AI 隐身 |
| 5s | 买装（推荐出装 + 合成树逐级补件，250 金币起） |
| 持续 | 恢复术、血包、目标 10m 内放技能 |
| 60s（≥4min） | TeamTactics 重算双方分路并下发 |

## 3. `_decide` 优先级（硬编码 if 链）

1. **P0** 己方水晶 15m 内有敌兵 → 直接清兵
2. **P0** 高地塔/水晶被打（50m 内才响应，贴塔后接手塔的仇恨目标）
3. **P1** 本线外塔/内塔被打（同上）
4. **P2** 血量 < 25% → `RECALL_SAFE`（找安全点回城，>`HP 2000` 后重新分配路）
5. **P3** 时间分叉：**<240s** 打野走 JungleStrategy、线上走 LaneStrategy；**≥240s** 打龙集合优先，其次仍走两条 Strategy，只是 `lane` 由 TeamTactics 指定
6. 目标在 10m 内 → `SkillTactics.try_best_combo`

## 4. 策略要点

- **分路**：按 role 固定（射手/辅助=发育路，法师=中，刺客=打野，战士/坦克=对抗路）；路判定用 `x+z` 符号，不是几何距离。
- **线上目标优先级**：最近攻击者 → 残血敌兵（跳过无兵掩护的敌塔）→ 敌英雄（不在其塔下、非不可选中）→ 敌塔（需兵线掩护）。
- **防守**：25m 内我方总血 < 敌方 ×0.6 → 退到最外塔内侧 1m。
- **中路**：本路无兵无目标 → 随机换边路；中路塔被威胁或 30s 无目标换回。
- **打野**：`FARM半区 → 线上 → CLASH半区 → 线上` 循环，野区清空即推进阶段，线上单段最长 30s。
- **4min 后**：经济领先 ≥2000 选敌方塔最多的路，落后 ≥3000 选己方塔最少的路，否则随机（中路权重 ×2）；模式 4-1 / 1-3-1 各 50% 随机；**龙存活且经济差 ≤3000 → 全队打龙**（优先龙坑旁残血敌英雄，否则锁龙，跳过原初羁绊龙）。
- **战争迷雾**：敌方 AI 的 `visible` 仅当 15m 内有敌英雄 / 12m 内敌兵 / 12m 内敌塔时为真。
- **联机**：host 权威；真人席位英雄先 `is_ai=true` 但不挂 HeroAI，`_scan_assignments` 找到空闲英雄后 `queue_free(HeroAI)` + `net_taken=true`（禁自动追击），改由远端输入直驱；掉线只清输入、原地待命，**不会重挂 AI**（[NetSession.gd](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L590)）。

## 5. 现状问题（按优先级）

1. **三套决策只跑一套**：`AiCoordinator`（已标 @deprecated）、`AiStateMachine`/`BehaviorScorer`/`DecisionContext`（`_ready` 里被注释掉）、`behaviors/*` 四个类（全项目零实例化）——约 800 行死代码。
2. **状态机名存实亡**：`state` 只是标签，4 分钟后恒为 PUSH/FARM，`RETREAT/AVOID/DEFEND` 永不进入，撤退/避战散落在各策略内部直接写 `move_target`。
3. **难度表半休眠**：`AiConfig.difficulty` 无人赋值（恒 GOLD），`diff()`/`skill_hits()`/`score_jitter()` 无调用点，`prediction_frames`/`vision_use` 无实现 → 实际只有 `should_skip_think()` 生效，而 GOLD 的 reaction_delay=0，等于没有难度分级；技能也从不预判。
4. **连招链断裂**：`_execute_combo` 存了 `ai_combo` meta，但 `continue_combo()` 全项目无调用 → 连招只放第一段。
5. **时间硬切**：240s 前不看塔血量与经济，240s 后突切团队分推，节奏断层。
6. **英雄特判分散**：3 个 brain 在 `ai/hero_brains/`，但孙悟空筋斗云、马超/铠的 AI 普攻门写在 `Hero.gd` 的 `is_ai` 分支里 → 加英雄要同时改两处。
7. **感知无缓存**：每 AI 每 tick 全量遍历 `entities/heroes/minions/turrets` 组 + 逐实体距离，10 英雄规模下是主要 CPU 热点。
8. **硬编码坐标/单位**：水晶 ±53、泉水 ±60 写死；塔射程统一 `×0.01` 换算，地图一改全废。

**建议重整顺序**：删/归档死代码 → 英雄特判收敛进 brain → 接难度表（含预判）→ 补连招链 → 感知快照缓存 → 最后再决定“状态机 or if 链”留一套。

5. **P3** 时间分叉：**<240s** 打野走 JungleStrategy、线上走 LaneStrategy；**≥240s** 打龙集合优先，其次仍走两条 Strategy，只是 `lane` 由 TeamTactics 指定
6. 目标在 10m 内 → `SkillTactics.try_best_combo`

## 4. 策略要点

- **分路**：按 role 固定（射手/辅助=发育路，法师=中，刺客=打野，战士/坦克=对抗路）；路判定用 `x+z` 符号，不是几何距离。
- **线上目标优先级**：最近攻击者 → 残血敌兵（跳过无兵掩护的敌塔）→ 敌英雄（不在其塔下、非不可选中）→ 敌塔（需兵线掩护）。
- **防守**：25m 内我方总血 < 敌方 ×0.6 → 退到最外塔内侧 1m。
- **中路**：本路无兵无目标 → 随机换边路；中路塔被威胁或 30s 无目标换回。
- **打野**：`FARM半区 → 线上 → CLASH半区 → 线上` 循环，野区清空即推进阶段，线上单段最长 30s。
- **4min 后**：经济领先 ≥2000 选敌方塔最多的路，落后 ≥3000 选己方塔最少的路，否则随机（中路权重 ×2）；模式 4-1 / 1-3-1 各 50% 随机；**龙存活且经济差 ≤3000 → 全队打龙**（优先龙坑旁残血敌英雄，否则锁龙，跳过原初羁绊龙）。
- **战争迷雾**：敌方 AI 的 `visible` 仅当 15m 内有敌英雄 / 12m 内敌兵 / 12m 内敌塔时为真。
- **联机**：host 权威；真人席位英雄先 `is_ai=true` 但不挂 HeroAI，`_scan_assignments` 找到空闲英雄后 `queue_free(HeroAI)` + `net_taken=true`（禁自动追击），改由远端输入直驱；掉线只清输入、原地待命，**不会重挂 AI**（[NetSession.gd](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L590)）。

## 5. 现状问题（按优先级）

1. **三套决策只跑一套**：`AiCoordinator`（已标 @deprecated）、`AiStateMachine`/`BehaviorScorer`/`DecisionContext`（`_ready` 里被注释掉）、`behaviors/*` 四个类（全项目零实例化）——约 800 行死代码。
2. **状态机名存实亡**：`state` 只是标签，4 分钟后恒为 PUSH/FARM，`RETREAT/AVOID/DEFEND` 永不进入，撤退/避战散落在各策略内部直接写 `move_target`。
3. **难度表半休眠**：`AiConfig.difficulty` 无人赋值（恒 GOLD），`diff()`/`skill_hits()`/`score_jitter()` 无调用点，`prediction_frames`/`vision_use` 无实现 → 实际只有 `should_skip_think()` 生效，而 GOLD 的 reaction_delay=0，等于没有难度分级；技能也从不预判。
4. **连招链断裂**：`_execute_combo` 存了 `ai_combo` meta，但 `continue_combo()` 全项目无调用 → 连招只放第一段。
5. **时间硬切**：240s 前不看塔血量与经济，240s 后突切团队分推，节奏断层。
6. **英雄特判分散**：3 个 brain 在 `ai/hero_brains/`，但孙悟空筋斗云、马超/铠的 AI 普攻门写在 `Hero.gd` 的 `is_ai` 分支里 → 加英雄要同时改两处。
7. **感知无缓存**：每 AI 每 tick 全量遍历 `entities/heroes/minions/turrets` 组 + 逐实体距离，10 英雄规模下是主要 CPU 热点。
8. **硬编码坐标/单位**：水晶 ±53、泉水 ±60 写死；塔射程统一 `×0.01` 换算，地图一改全废。

**建议重整顺序**：删/归档死代码 → 英雄特判收敛进 brain → 接难度表（含预判）→ 补连招链 → 感知快照缓存 → 最后再决定“状态机 or if 链”留一套。

需要的话我可以把这份梳理落成 `docs/ai-architecture.md`，或直接按上面第 1 项开始清死代码。

```gdscript
func update_combo(delta) -> bool:

    if combo_wait > 0: return false
```

```
func continue_combo() -> bool:
	...
```

New design:

vars:
```gdscript
# --- 连招链状态 ---
var _combo_skills: Array = []      # 当前连招的技能序列
var _combo_step: int = 0           # 已释放到第几段（0 = 起手段已放）
var _combo_target: GameEntity = null
var _combo_wait: float = 0.0       # 距下一段可释放的等待时间
```

`try_best_combo` passes target:
`_execute_combo(combo, target)` (change signature to GameEntity).

```gdscript
# 执行连招起手技能，并记录后续段（由 update_combo 衔接）
func _execute_combo(combo: Dictionary, target: GameEntity) -> void:
	var skills: Array = combo.get("skills", [])
	var first_idx: int = skills[0]
	skill_feed_timer = AiConfig.SKILL_FEED_COOLDOWN
	_start_combo_skill(first_idx, target)
	_combo_skills = skills
	_combo_step = 0
	_combo_target = target
	_combo_wait = _step_gap(hero.skills[first_idx])
```

`_start_combo_skill(idx, target)` calls hero._start_casting(idx, hero.skills[idx], target.global_position).

`_step_gap(sk)`: maxf(sk.cast_time, AiConfig.COMBO_STEP_GAP).

`update_combo(delta) -> bool`:
```gdscript
func update_combo(delta: float) -> bool:
	if _combo_skills.is_empty():
		return false
	# 目标失效 / 被换目标 / 自身不可行动 → 中止连招
	if not is_instance_valid(_combo_target) or _combo_target.health <= 0 \
			or not is_instance_valid(hero) or hero.is_dead \
			or hero.manual_target != _combo_target \
			or hero.casting_skill or hero.channeling_skill_index >= 0 \
			or hero.stun_timer > 0.0 or hero.knockup_timer > 0.0 \
			or hero.froze_timer > 0.0 or hero.suppress_timer > 0.0 or hero.silence_timer > 0.0:
		_clear_combo()
		return false
	_combo_wait -= delta
	if _combo_wait > 0.0:
		return false
	_combo_step += 1
	if _combo_step >= _combo_skills.size():
		_clear_combo()
		return false
	var idx: int = _combo_skills[_combo_step]
	if idx >= hero.skills.size() or hero.skills[idx] == null \
			or hero.skill_levels[idx] <= 0 or hero.skill_cooldowns[idx] > 0.0 \
			or hero.mana < hero.skills[idx].mana_cost \
			or hero.global_position.distance_to(_combo_target.global_position) > AiConfig.SKILL_USE_RANGE \
			or not _can_use_skill_on(idx, _combo_target):
		_clear_combo()
		return false
	_start_combo_skill(idx, _combo_target)
	_combo_wait = _step_gap(hero.skills[idx])
	return true
```

Note `hero.skill_cooldowns` array access safe.

`_clear_combo()`:
```gdscript
func _clear_combo() -> void:
	_combo_skills = []
	_combo_step = 0
	_combo_target = null
	_combo_wait = 0.0
```

Also should clear combo when starting new combo. `_execute_combo` overwrites.

Also `update(delta)` decrements feed timer; update_combo separate.

Need AiConfig.COMBO_STEP_GAP const. Add near SKILL_FEED_COOLDOWN.

Also `try_best_combo` currently passes `target.global_position`; change to target.

Careful: `_execute_combo(combo, target)` then `hero._start_casting`. If _start_casting fails (e.g., not enough mana — already checked) fine.

Also `hero.manual_target != _combo_target` — hero.manual_target may be set by Human... AI only. `set_manual_target` may clear if dead. Fine.

One risk: HeroAI calls `skill_tactics.update_combo(delta)` every frame at top (after dead check), but then `_try_use_skills` near bottom may start a new combo in the same frame if manual_target in range and feed timer == 0. Could this cause immediate chain conflicts? try_best_combo sets feed timer 2s so no double per frame.

Another risk: `update_combo` returns true (casts) each step; casting may cancel move? `_start_casting` likely stops movement; that's intended.

Now also: when hero AI state changes to retreat/recall, manual_target gets cleared → combo cleared. Good.

Implement edits.

{"file_path":"ai\tactics\SkillTactics.gd","new_string":"# 执行连招起手技能，并记录后续段（由 update_combo 衔接）
func _execute_combo(combo: Dictionary, target: GameEntity) -> void:
	var skills: Array = combo.get("skills", [])
	var first_idx: int = skills[0]
	skill_feed_timer = AiConfig.SKILL_FEED_COOLDOWN
	_start_combo_skill(first_idx, target)
	_combo_skills = skills
	_combo_step = 0
	_combo_target = target
	_combo_wait = _step_gap(hero.skills[first_idx])


# 每帧推进连招链：目标失效 / 换目标 / 受控 / 不可行动 → 直接中止
func update_combo(delta: float) -> bool:
	if _combo_skills.is_empty():
		return false
	if not is_instance_valid(_combo_target) or _combo_target.health <= 0 \
			or not is_instance_valid(hero) or hero.is_dead \
			or hero.manual_target != _combo_target \
			or hero.casting_skill or hero.channeling_skill_index >= 0 \
			or hero.stun_timer > 0.0 or hero.knockup_timer > 0.0 \
			or hero.froze_timer > 0.0 or hero.suppress_timer > 0.0 or hero.silence_timer > 0.0:
		_clear_combo()
		return false
	_combo_wait -= delta
	if _combo_wait > 0.0:
		return false
	_combo_step += 1
	if _combo_step >= _combo_skills.size():
		_clear_combo()
		return false  # 连招结束
	var idx: int = _combo_skills[_combo_step]
	if idx >= hero.skills.size() or hero.skills[idx] == null \
			or hero.skill_levels[idx] <= 0 or hero.skill_cooldowns[idx] > 0.0 \
			or hero.mana < hero.skills[idx].mana_cost \
			or hero.global_position.distance_to(_combo_target.global_position) > AiConfig.SKILL_USE_RANGE \
			or not _can_use_skill_on(idx, _combo_target):
		_clear_combo()
		return false
	_start_combo_skill(idx, _combo_target)
	_combo_wait = _step_gap(hero.skills[idx])
	return true


func _start_combo_skill(idx: int, target: GameEntity) -> void:
	hero._start_casting(idx, hero.skills[idx], target.global_position)


# 段间间隔：至少等技能自身前摇结束，再留一点手感间隔
func _step_gap(sk: Skill) -> float:
	return maxf(sk.cast_time, AiConfig.COMBO_STEP_GAP)


func _clear_combo() -> void:
	_combo_skills = []
	_combo_step = 0
	_combo_target = null
	_combo_wait = 0.0
","old_string":"# 执行连招第一个技能（后续由连招链自动衔接）
func _execute_combo(combo: Dictionary, target_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	var skills: Array = combo.get("skills", [])
	var first_idx: int = skills[0]
	skill_feed_timer = AiConfig.SKILL_FEED_COOLDOWN
	hero._start_casting(first_idx, hero.skills[first_idx], target_pos)
	# 存储当前连招引用，供后续 _continue_combo 使用
	hero.set_meta("ai_combo", combo)
	hero.set_meta("ai_combo_step", 0)
	hero.set_meta("ai_combo_target", target_pos)


# 继续连招下一技能（在技能释放完成后调用）
func continue_combo() -> bool:
	var combo: Dictionary = hero.get_meta("ai_combo", {})
	if combo.is_empty():
		return false
	var step: int = hero.get_meta("ai_combo_step", 0)
	var skills: Array = combo.get("skills", [])
	var target_pos: Vector3 = hero.get_meta("ai_combo_target", Vector3.ZERO)

	step += 1
	if step >= skills.size():
		hero.remove_meta("ai_combo")
		hero.remove_meta("ai_combo_step")
		hero.remove_meta("ai_combo_target")
		return false  # 连招结束

	var idx: int = skills[step]
	if idx < hero.skills.size() and hero.skill_cooldowns[idx] <= 0 and hero.mana >= hero.skills[idx].mana_cost:
		hero.set_meta("ai_combo_step", step)
		hero._start_casting(idx, hero.skills[idx], target_pos)
		return true

	return false
"}

下一步之前先修一个bug：AI英雄在回城时血没回满就离开了泉水

The user reports a bug: AI hero leaves the fountain before health is full when recalling/healing at base.

Look at HeroAI._recall_safe_behavior:

```gdscript
func _recall_safe_behavior(delta):
	# 英雄特判（孙悟空筋斗云飞行中/已在泉水）→ 本英雄自行处理
	if brain.handle_recall_safe():
		return
	# 已在泉水中 → 等待自动回血，由_decide恢复状态
	if hero.health>2000:
		hero.cancel_recall()
		_assign_lane()
		return
	var safe_pos = _find_safe_recall_spot()
	if safe_pos != Vector3.ZERO:
		if hero.global_position.distance_to(safe_pos) > 2.0:
			hero.move_target = safe_pos
		else:
			if not hero.is_recalling:
				hero.start_recall()
	else:
		_move_to_friendly_turret()
```

Wait, condition `if hero.health > 2000` — absolute HP threshold, not fraction! That's likely the bug: as soon as HP > 2000 (any hero with max HP above 2000 after a bit of fountain regen), the AI cancels recall/leaves base with partial HP. High-HP heroes (3000-4000+) leave at 2000/4000 = 50%.

Also `_decide()` sets `state = RECALL_SAFE` when `health < 25%`; then `_recall_safe_behavior` runs each frame. When reward fills above 2000 → cancel and assign lane (go out). So yes, bug: threshold should be based on max HP (e.g., HEALTH_DEFEND 0.5? or full?). The user says "血没回满就离开了泉水" — expected to wait until full (or high) HP.

Let me examine the recall/heal mechanics: fountain likely regenerates HP quickly near spawn. The correct fix: wait until HP ratio >= some threshold (e.g. 0.95 or 1.0) and mana ratio >= threshold too, then leave. Also must handle "already in fountain" — check distance to spawn.

Also there's an issue: if hero health never exceeds 2000? e.g., low max HP? Most heroes max HP > 2000.

Let me look for the actual heal logic: maybe `_decide` while in RECALL_SAFE? Also Hero's fountain regen: search for "spawn" regen in Hero.gd/BattleManager (near fountain heal). Let me check how player heals at fountain: probably in Hero._physics_process or GameEntity `_apply_fountain_regen`.

Also potential issue: `hero.is_recalling` — recall completes when? `start_recall()` sets is_recalling, recall_timer = RECALL_DURATION (4s), teleports to fountain on completion. Then in fountain, AI should wait for heal. But maybe after recall completes, `_decide` sets state=PUSH again because health > 25%? Then leaves immediately. Hmm: `_decide` checks `if health < max*0.25 → RECALL_SAFE`, else continues to lane strategy → PUSH and LaneStrategy sets move_target → walks out. So even with proper threshold in `_recall_safe_behavior`, once HP > 25% the state machine leaves. That's the real bug path: after recall lands with e.g. 30% HP, `_decide` no longer sets RECALL_SAFE, and lane strategy sends the hero out; fountain heal might be fast but not full.

Wait order in `_process`: `_decide()` runs on think tick and sets state; then at the end of `_process`, `if state == State.RECALL_SAFE: _recall_safe_behavior(delta)`. If `_decide` sets state = PUSH (because health >= 25%), the recall-safe behavior is skipped → hero walks back to lane. So the AI only stays in base while HP < 25%? Then how does `health > 2000` matter? At spawn, health <25% triggers RECALL_SAFE; as soon as HP crosses 2000 (or never below), it leaves.

Hmm wait: `_decide`'s recall condition is checked after defense handling; if health < 25% → state = RECALL_SAFE. So hero recalls. After arriving at fountain, heals fast (fountain regen maybe 1% per frame?), HP rises above 25% quickly → `_decide` sets PUSH → leaves with ~30% HP. That matches bug report: leaves before full.

But also the `health > 2000` check in `_recall_safe_behavior` may never be reached.

Need to design fix:
1. Track "needs healing at base" state: when AI recalls/returns to base, stay until HP (and mana) recovered above threshold, e.g. 95% or 100%.
2. `_decide` should not override RECALL_SAFE until recovery complete: e.g., if hero is at/near spawn and HP ratio < some threshold (e.g., 0.9), keep state RECALL_SAFE and skip lane decisions.

Implementation sketch:
- In HeroAI._decide, before lane logic: 
```gdscript
	# 在泉水养伤：血量未回到 HEALTH_SAFE 前不出去
	if _is_at_fountain() and (hp_ratio < HEALTH_RECOVERY or mp_ratio < MANA_RECOVERY):
		state = State.RECALL_SAFE
		return
```
- In `_recall_safe_behavior`, replace `if hero.health > 2000` with ratio check: `if hp_ratio >= RECOVERY and mp_ratio >= RECOVERY: cancel & assign lane`. And when not yet recovered → stay put at fountain (move_target = spawn position?) and don't walk to safe spot.

Also need `_is_at_fountain()`: distance to spawn < SPAWN_DETECT_RANGE? There's fountain heal radius maybe. Let me find the fountain regen logic to get the right radius and heal rate.

Also mana: AI might need mana too.

Let me grep for fountain/spring healing: "spring", "fountain", "泉水", "regen" in Hero.gd/BattleManager.

Also recall completion teleport: find where recall completes (`recall_timer`), maybe in Hero._physics_process.

Let me investigate. Then implement with minimal changes, verify compile + maybe simulate? Could write a quick headless test? Hard. At least compile-check; logic reasoning.

Also possibly the same absolute-2000 pattern elsewhere in AI code? grep ">2000" or "2000" in ai/.

Let me search.

Key facts:
- Fountain: spawn points at (-62,0,62) / (62,0,-62), heal radius 3.6, heal applied in Hero.gd ~1396. Note HeroAI uses spawn (-60,60) for spawn detection (SPAWN_DETECT 8). Fountain center is ±62, radius 3.6.
- The bug: `if hero.health>2000:` absolute threshold in `_recall_safe_behavior` → leaves with partial HP.

Also the deeper issue: `_decide` sets RECALL_SAFE only when health < 25%. After arriving at fountain, HP rises; once ≥25%, `_decide` sets PUSH and lane strategy sends it out — before `_recall_safe_behavior`'s `health>2000` even matters. Let's trace: _process order each frame: think tick → _decide() (only when think_timer<=0) sets state; then later `if state == RECALL_SAFE: _recall_safe_behavior(delta)`.

So while HP < 25%: state RECALL_SAFE, recall behavior→ hero walks to safe pos → start_recall → after 4s teleports to fountain. Then HP recovers quickly (fountain heal rate? check Hero.gd 1396-1420). HP crosses 25% → next think tick _decide sets PUSH → hero leaves with maybe 30% HP. So `health > 2000` may not even be relevant for most cases... but the user observes "血没回满就离开了泉水" — consistent.

Wait, actually could the bug be different? Maybe when `hero.health < 25%` the AI recalls; but there's the check in `_recall_safe_behavior` `if hero.health>2000` which for a hero with 4000 max at 25% = 1000, so it leaves only when 2000 (50%)... but _decide already switches at 25%. So depending on order, the hero leaves around 25-50%.

Also note: after `_assign_lane()` in recall behavior, `state` is reset.

The right fix: introduce a "base recovery" gate:
- While hero is in own fountain (distance <= fountain radius, or in_own_fountain()) and (hp_ratio < RECOVER_DONE or mp_ratio < RECOVER_DONE): keep state RECALL_SAFE, hold position (don't move out), don't recall again.
- Define RECOVER thresholds in AiConfig, e.g. HEALTH_RECOVERED = 0.95? User says "血没回满" → wait until full (1.0) or nearly. Mana too (mana matters). Use `HEALTH_RECOVER_FULL = 1.0`? Floating equality issues: hp regeneration ticks; use >= 0.99 or mana >= 0.99. Better: 0.98 threshold to avoid waiting forever due to regen rounding.

But careful: if hero has max HP reduced by items? actual_max_health used everywhere.

Design:
In AiConfig add:
```
const HEALTH_RECOVERED: float = 0.98   # 泉水养伤完成阈值（血量/蓝量）
```

In HeroAI:
- Add helper:
```gdscript
func _in_own_fountain() -> bool:
	var spring := Vector3(-62, 0, 62) if hero.team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(62, 0, -62)
	return hero.global_position.distance_to(spring) <= 3.6
```
Hero already has `in_own_fountain()` method (line 3954) — reuse it! `hero.in_own_fountain()`.

- In `_decide`, before the recall check:
```gdscript
	# 泉水养伤：血量/蓝量未回满前不出去（修 AI 半血离泉）
	if hero.in_own_fountain():
		var hp_ok := hero.health >= hero.actual_max_health * AiConfig.HEALTH_RECOVERED
		var mp_ok := hero.mana >= hero.actual_mana_max * AiConfig.HEALTH_RECOVERED
		if not hp_ok or not mp_ok:
			state = State.RECALL_SAFE
			return
```
Place this BEFORE `_handle_high_defense()`? If base is under attack and hero at fountain, defense should take priority? Hmm: high defense: crystal being attacked by minions at 15m — fountain is at (-62,62) far from crystal (-53,53)? distance ~13. If crystal attacked while hero in fountain, hero should defend (P0). So place the fountain-wait AFTER `_handle_high_defense()` and `_handle_lane_turret_defense()` but BEFORE the hp<25% recall check. Hmm, but P0 crystal defense with minions within 15 — at fountain may respond. That's fine/desirable.

Actually simpler: place right before the `if hero.health < ... HEALTH_RECALL` check. Then even if HP > 25% but not full, we set RECALL_SAFE and return (skipping lane strategies).

- In `_recall_safe_behavior`:
  - Replace `if hero.health>2000:` absolute check with recovered check:
```gdscript
	if hero.in_own_fountain():
		if _recovered():
			hero.cancel_recall()
			_assign_lane()
		# 未回满：原地待着，别走去安全点/别重复回城
		hero.move_target = Vector3.ZERO
		return
```
Wait original `if hero.health>2000` did cancel + assign lane and return; else falls to find safe recall spot. If already in fountain but not full, walking to "safe recall spot" (nearest friendly turret + dir*2 or nearest bush) would move it OUT of fountain — bad. Original code would do that whenever health <= 2000 while in fountain! And `hero.start_recall()`... That may be part of the bug too.

New:
```gdscript
	# 已在自家泉水：养伤到血/蓝基本回满再出门；不满则原地待着
	if hero.in_own_fountain():
		if hero.is_recalling:
			hero.cancel_recall()
		if _fully_recovered():
			_assign_lane()
		else:
			hero.move_target = hero.global_position
			hero.manual_target = null
		return
```
Note: `_assign_lane()` sets state PUSH/FARM, manual_target null, move_target = hero.global_position. Then next tick _decide → lane strategy moves out. Good. But if we `_assign_lane()` while still not recovered? No, only when recovered.

But also after _assign_lane, `_decide` next tick: `hero.in_own_fountain()` check — already recovered so passes. Fine.

Also when recovered and assign lane: the hero may still be `is_recalling`? We cancel first.

- Also `_recall_safe_behavior` currently: `if hero.health>2000: hero.cancel_recall(); _assign_lane(); return` — this was the "leftover HP >2000" case even when not in fountain (walked into base but not in fountain radius). Replace with the fountain-aware logic + fallback: if not in fountain (e.g., near spawn but outside radius 3.6), move to fountain center rather than recall again:
```gdscript
	if not hero.in_own_fountain():
		# 不在泉眼但在基地附近？继续按通用流程找安全点回城
```
Original behavior: if `health <= 2000` and not in fountain → find safe recall spot → walk → start_recall. Hmm that's the "recall" loop. But if hero is already at spawn area (recall just completed) it's within radius 3.6 of ±62? Recall teleport puts hero at fountain (Hero.gd 1388 "到达泉水上空"). With SPAWN_DETECT_RANGE 8 and spawn (-60,60) vs fountain center (-62,62) distance 2.8, so in_own_fountain true.

Additionally there's `_decide` early "复活/泉水检测: if distance(spawn) < SPAWN_DETECT_RANGE and not has_respawned_recently: _assign_lane()" — on respawn, it assigns lane while in fountain, then `_decide`... but health after respawn is full presumably, fine.

Now: what does `_decide` do if hero is in fountain with full HP? Nothing special → lane strategy may send it out — fine.

What about mana? AI cares about mana for skills. Recover only if both hp and mp near full. Note `_try_use_recover` (recover skill) is used when hp<70% or mana<70% — in fountain, hero would use recover? That doesn't matter.

Hmm, but is waiting for mana 98% too strict? Mana regen at fountain is fast presumably. Let me check the fountain heal code (Hero.gd 1396-1430) to know rates: likely health += max_health*0.1*delta, mana += max_mana*0.1*delta or similar. Let me read.

Also confirm `actual_mana_max` name used elsewhere (yes HeroAI uses `hero.actual_mana_max`).

```gdscript
	# 泉水养伤：在自家泉水范围内血/蓝未回满前不出门（原来半血就走）
	if hero.in_own_fountain() and not _fully_recovered():
		state = State.RECALL_SAFE
		return
```
4. `_recall_safe_behavior`: handle in-fountain case:
```gdscript
func _recall_safe_behavior(delta):
	if brain.handle_recall_safe():
		return
	# 已在自家泉水：养伤到血/蓝基本回满；未满则原地待着（别走去安全点、别重复回城）
	if hero.in_own_fountain():
		if hero.is_recalling:
			hero.cancel_recall()
		if _fully_recovered():
			_assign_lane()
		else:
			hero.move_target = hero.global_position
			hero.manual_target = null
		return
	# 未在泉水：走到安全点后回城
	var safe_pos = _find_safe_recall_spot()
	...
```
Remove old `if hero.health>2000:` block.

Wait: what about a hero at base but outside fountain radius (walking in)? Original: health>2000 → cancel recall & assign lane (leave) — that's the leak. New: falls to recall logic; `hero.start_recall()` might be triggered far from fountain? If hero is at base but not in fountain, safe_pos = nearest friendly turret + 2 → walks to turret then start_recall → teleport to fountain. Hmm at base the nearest friendly turret might be the crystal, sending hero back out. But recall completion teleports to fountain anyway (Hero recall logic teleports to spring), so it's fine-ish.

But: when a hero's recall is interrupted/at spawn... Fine.

Also, important: `_fully_recovered` using actual_max_health; if hero has items granting max HP, at fountain regen 20%/s → asymptotic? Regen linear 20% per second capped by `_apply_healing` probably clamps to max. It should reach 100% in ~5s. 0.98 threshold ok.

Mana: `actual_mana_max`; heroes with mana. For heroes without mana (张飞? energy?), actual_mana_max maybe 0 → `hero.mana >= 0*0.98` true → fine (division not used). Good: use `hero.mana >= hero.actual_mana_max * HEALTH_RECOVERED` — if max 0, mana presumably 0 → 0 >= 0 true. OK.

Another consideration: while waiting at fountain, `hero.move_target = hero.global_position` — Hero._physics_process treats move_target as target; distance 0 → clears it (`if dir.length() < 0.3: move_target = Vector3.ZERO`). Then AI next tick re-sets; hero stays. Alternatively set `Vector3.ZERO` to mean no movement. Setting to global_position is also fine but may trigger path logic; better set ZERO to keep stationary: In Hero, `move_target != Vector3.ZERO` drives movement; zero means idle. LaneStrategy etc set move_target. So in fountain waiting, set `hero.move_target = Vector3.ZERO` and `manual_target = null`. But Hero's `if is_recalling and not is_ai ...` irrelevant. OK use ZERO.

But wait: `_recall_safe_behavior` is called AFTER `_dodge_threats()` early return etc. Fine.

Also: when in fountain and not recovered, the AI shouldn't buy? Buying continues (good).

8. Additional path: AI hero with 25-90% HP walking around lane decides to recall? Only recalls at <25%. So low-HP leave issue only after recall.

But there's another leak: `_decide` at HP 25% sets RECALL_SAFE; `_recall_safe_behavior` walks to safe point then `hero.start_recall()`; but what if hero enters fountain radius by walking (e.g., retreat movement/lane path)? Then our new check keeps it until full. Good.

Summary of the bug fix:
根因: 
1. `_decide` 只在血量 <25% 时维持 RECALL_SAFE；到泉后血量回一点过 25% 就切回 PUSH，分路策略立刻把人带出泉 → 半血出门。
2. `_recall_safe_behavior` 用的是绝对阈值 `health > 2000`（不是按最大生命比例），4000 血英雄 50% 就会 cancel_recall + _assign_lane；且该分支在泉外也生效。
3. 血包分支在 40% 以下时会把 `move_target` 指向线上血包并 return，抢先于泉水养伤逻辑，也会把人带出泉。

修复:
- Hero: 抽出通用 `is_in_own_fountain()`（±62、半径 3.6，与泉水回复同源），`in_own_fountain()`（元流专用）改为委托；泉水回复块改用它，保证"养伤半径=回血半径"永远一致。
- AiConfig: 新增 `HEALTH_RECOVERED = 0.98`。
- HeroAI: `_decide` 在防御判断之后加"泉水中未回满 → 保持 RECALL_SAFE 并 return"；`_recall_safe_behavior` 在泉水中时原地待命（清 move_target/manual_target、取消读条），回满才 `_assign_lane()`；删除 `health > 2000`；血包分支加 `not is_in_own_fountain()`。

验证: 场景化无头测试 4 条断言全过（20%/60% 血、满血 30% 蓝都不走，满血满蓝才恢复分路）；18 脚本编译通过；battle.tscn 冒烟无错误。

Note: 数值 0.98 可调；如果觉得应该等蓝满/只需血满，可以改 `_fully_recovered`。

Also mention: 复现/验证脚本临时放在 .tmp（已删）。

Let me clean up and notify.

这个 bug 已修复，并用无头行为测试验证（4/4 通过）。

## 根因（三条路径叠加）

1. **决策层只看 25% 线**：`_decide()` 仅在 `health < 25%` 时维持 `RECALL_SAFE`；到泉后血量一过 25% 就切回 `PUSH`，分路策略立刻把英雄带出泉 → 半血出门。这是主因。
2. **回城行为用绝对血量**：`_recall_safe_behavior` 里是 `if hero.health > 2000`（不是按最大生命比例）。4000 血英雄 50% 就 `cancel_recall + _assign_lane()`；且该分支在泉外也生效。
3. **血包抢跑**：`health < 40%` 时血包分支直接把 `move_target` 指向线上血包并 `return`，抢在泉水养伤逻辑之前，也会把人带出泉。

## 改动

- [Hero.gd:3953](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L3953) 抽出通用 `is_in_own_fountain()`（自家泉眼 ±62、半径 3.6），元流专用的 `in_own_fountain()` 改为委托它；[泉水回复段:1396](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L1396) 也改用它 —— 以后"养伤半径 = 回血半径"永远同源，不会再出现两套坐标。
- [AiConfig.gd:13](ai/AiConfig.gd#L13) 新增 `HEALTH_RECOVERED = 0.98`（养伤完成线）。
- [HeroAI.gd:354](ai/HeroAI.gd#L354) `_decide` 在防御判断之后加闸门：**在自家泉水且血/蓝未到 0.98 → 保持 `RECALL_SAFE` 并 return**，不再进入分路策略。
- [HeroAI.gd:633](ai/HeroAI.gd#L633) `_recall_safe_behavior`：在泉水中就原地待命（清 `move_target`/`manual_target`、取消读条、不走去"安全点"、不重复回城），回满才 `_assign_lane()`；删掉 `health > 2000` 绝对阈值。
- [HeroAI.gd:297](ai/HeroAI.gd#L297) 血包分支加 `not is_in_own_fountain()`，泉水养伤期间不抢血包。
- [HeroAI.gd:653](ai/HeroAI.gd#L653) 新增 `_fully_recovered()`：血满，且（有蓝英雄）蓝也满。

## 验证

用无头场景跑了 4 条断言（临时测试脚本已删）：

| 场景 | 期望 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 泉水中 20% 血 | 留泉、不设移动目标 | ✅ |
| 60% 血 | 仍留泉（旧逻辑此处会走） | ✅ |
| 血满、蓝 30% | 仍留泉 | ✅ |
| 血蓝回满 | 退出 `RECALL_SAFE`、恢复分路 | ✅ |

另：18 个 AI/核心脚本编译通过，`battle.tscn` 冒烟无 SCRIPT ERROR。

## 可调项

- 第 3 条"蓝也要满"是我补的（法师/打野常因缺蓝二次回城）。若只想等血，把 `_fully_recovered()` 里的 mana 判断删掉即可。
- 0.98 是按泉水 20%/秒回复速率选的（约 3–5 秒回满），改 `HEALTH_RECOVERED` 即可调"回多满才出门"。

试玩时可以重点看：残血回城后是否在泉边站满再走、以及泉水被围攻时是否仍会响应高地/水晶防守（P0 防守优先级高于养伤，我刻意保留了）。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

```gdscript
func _ready():
	var fails := 0
	# 名称与参数读取
	AiConfig.difficulty = AiConfig.Difficulty.KING
	if AiConfig.difficulty_name() != "王者": fails+=1; print(...)
	if AiConfig.prediction_frames() != 3: fails+=1

	AiConfig.difficulty = AiConfig.Difficulty.BRONZE
	if AiConfig.difficulty_name() != "青铜": fails+=1
	if not is_equal_approx(AiConfig.skill_accuracy(), 0.55): fails+=1

	# 瞄准：王者对静止目标零误差
	var HeroScript = load("res://scripts/entities/Hero.gd")

	target.velocity = Vector3.ZERO

	var t1 = Tactics.new(null, null)
	AiConfig.difficulty = AiConfig.Difficulty.KING
	var aim = t1._aim_pos(target)
	if aim != target.global_position: fails+=1; print("FAIL KING aim=", aim)

	# 王者预判：速度 (0,0,10) → z 提前 1.5m
	target.velocity = Vector3(0,0,10)
	var aim2 = t1._aim_pos(target)
	if absf(aim2.z - (target.global_position.z + 1.5)) > 0.01: fails+=1; print("FAIL 预判 z=", aim2.z)
	target.velocity = Vector3.ZERO

	# 青铜：误差存在但不超过上限
	AiConfig.difficulty = AiConfig.Difficulty.BRONZE
	var maxd := 0.0
	var sum := 0.0
	for i in range(300):
		var p = t1._aim_pos(target)
		var d = p.distance_to(target.global_position)
		maxd = maxf(maxd, d)
		sum += d
	if sum / 300.0 <= 0.05: fails+=1; print("FAIL 青铜平均误差过小 ", sum/300.0)
	if maxd > 1.36: fails+=1; print("FAIL 青铜误差超上限 ", maxd)

	# 黄金：误差幅度更小
	AiConfig.difficulty = AiConfig.Difficulty.GOLD
	var maxd2 := 0.0
	for i in range(300): maxd2 = maxf(maxd2, t1._aim_pos(target).distance_to(target.global_position))
	if maxd2 > 0.37: fails+=1; print("FAIL 黄金误差超上限 ", maxd2)

	print("DIFF_TEST_DONE fails=", fails)
	get_tree().quit(0 if fails==0 else 1)
```

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Original: "请你梳理一下现在的AI架构" — produce an architecture review of the HonorKing AI system.
- Then: "开始修改吧" — start implementing the recommendations (dead code removal → hero special-case consolidation → difficulty table → combo chain → perception cache → state machine unification).
- Then: "继续" — proceed with the next refactor batch (hero special-casing into HeroBrain; done).
- **Current request (highest priority)**: "下一步之前先修一个bug：AI英雄在回城时血没回满就离开了泉水" — before the next refactor step, fix bug: AI heroes leave the fountain before HP is fully restored during recall/retreat.
- Earlier offer still open: git init + `.gitignore`; difficulty table needs product decisions (entry point location, default tier).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.5/4.7 project "HonorKing", GDScript only, no test suite, no git repository (important: no revert safety net).
- AI design: AI is a "commander" — `HeroAI` is a child `Node` of each `Hero`; it only writes `hero.manual_target`, `hero.move_target`, and calls `hero._start_casting(idx, skill, pos)`; movement/pathfinding/attacks/casting execute in `Hero._physics_process` / `GameEntity` (A* via `PathFinder`, `_avoid_walls`).
- Layers: `AiPerception` (read-only group queries) → tactics (`SkillTactics`/`SummonerTactics`/`ItemActiveTactics`) → phase strategies (`LaneStrategy`, `JungleStrategy`, 0–4 min) → `TeamTactics` (4 min+, centralized, driven by `BattleManager` every 60 s) → `HeroBrain` hero special-cases.
- Net: host authoritative; human takeover = `queue_free()` the `HeroAI` child + `net_taken = true` (hero keeps `is_ai = true`); disconnect leaves hero idle, no AI re-attach.
- Verification commands (Godot binary at `C:\Users\18749\AppData\Local\Temp\godot47.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe`, project targets 4.5 but only 4.7.2 available):
  - Script compile check via temp `extends SceneTree` script run with `--headless --path . --script res://.tmp/<name>.gd` (must first run `--headless --path . --editor --quit` to register new `class_name`s in `.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`).
  - Smoke: `& $g --headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 60` (or main scene lobby with `--quit-after 20`).
- Leftover Godot processes from smoke tests must be killed (`Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like "*odot*" } | Stop-Process -Force`).

## Files and Code
- `ai/HeroAI.gd` — main AI controller (~842 lines). Header comment added documenting layers; `state_machine`/`scorer` vars and commented init removed; `skill_tactics.brain = brain` injected after `brain = HeroBrain.create(...)`; `skill_tactics.update_combo(delta)` called each frame after the dead/invalid check (~line 249); `_recall_safe_behavior(delta)` now starts with `if brain.handle_recall_safe(): return` (~line 622), followed by `if hero.health > 2000: hero.cancel_recall(); _assign_lane(); return`, then `_find_safe_recall_spot()` → move to `safe_pos` → if within `2.0` and `not hero.is_recalling`: `hero.start_recall()`. `State` enum annotated as behavior tag only. Contains `_try_upgrade_skills()`, `_try_travel_dash()`, `_dodge_threats()`, `_dragon_rally_behavior()`, `_distribute`-related `apply_team_lane()`, `_handle_high_defense()`, `_handle_lane_turret_defense()`.
- `ai/tactics/SkillTactics.gd` — combo chain rewritten: state vars `_combo_skills`, `_combo_step`, `_combo_target`, `_combo_wait`; `_execute_combo(combo, target: GameEntity)`; new `update_combo(delta) -> bool` (aborts on invalid/dead target, `hero.manual_target != _combo_target`, casting/channeling, stun/knockup/froze/suppress/silence; re-checks level/CD/mana/distance `AiConfig.SKILL_USE_RANGE`/`_can_use_skill_on`); `_start_combo_skill()`, `_step_gap(sk) = maxf(sk.cast_time, AiConfig.COMBO_STEP_GAP)`, `_clear_combo()`; `var brain: HeroBrain = null`; `_turret_blocked(target)` and `_can_use_skill_on()` delegate to brain; old meta-based `continue_combo()` and `set_meta("ai_combo")` removed.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

难度表已打通（原计划的下一步 A 项），默认黄金档，行为与改动前基本一致。

## 改动

**1. 难度参数真正生效** — [SkillTactics.gd](ai/tactics/SkillTactics.gd)
- `_score_skill()` 末尾加评分抖动：低难度技能选择更"随意"（`score_jitter`）。
- 新增 `_aim_pos(target)`：按难度给瞄准点加**预判提前量**（1 帧 ≈ 50ms，按目标速度）和**落点误差**（`(1-精度)×3m` 随机偏移），`_start_combo_skill` / `use_best_skill` 都改用它。

**2. 难度表标定为"黄金=基准"** — [AiConfig.gd:137](ai/AiConfig.gd#L137)
- 重排数值：黄金保留旧手感（不预判、误差仅 ~0.36m），铂金/钻石/王者逐步加预判（1/2/3 帧），白银/青铜落点明显偏（误差上限 0.84m / 1.35m）。
- 新增 `difficulty_name()`、`skill_accuracy()`、`prediction_frames()` 读取接口。

**3. 入口 + 持久化**
- [PlayerPrefs](scripts/core/PlayerPrefs.gd)：`get_ai_difficulty()` / `set_ai_difficulty()`，默认黄金，存同一份偏好文件。
- [NetLobby 主菜单](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd)：分路选择下面加一行「AI难度」循环按钮，文案实时显示「黄金 · 反应 0.00s · 精度 88% · 预判 0 帧」，点一下切下一档（青铜→白银→黄金→铂金→钻石→王者）。
- [BattleManager._ready](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L187)：开局把本机偏好应用到 `AiConfig.difficulty`（联机只有 host 跑 AI，天然主机权威）。

## 验证

- 无头难度测试 4 组断言全过：王者 = 名称「王者」/精度 1.0/预判 3 帧、青铜 = 0.55；王者打静止目标零误差、对 10m/s 目标提前 1.5m；青铜 300 次采样平均偏移 >0.05m 且上限 ≤1.35m；黄金上限 ≤0.36m。
- 11 个改动相关脚本编译通过；大厅主场景 30 帧、`battle.tscn` 60 帧无头运行均无 SCRIPT/Parse 错误。

## 说明

- `vision_use` 仍只在表里预留未接入（已在注释标注）；`skill_hits()` 保留未用。
- 若觉得黄金档精度 88% 让 AI 变弱，把 `DIFF_TABLE` 里 GOLD 的 `skill_accuracy` 调回 1.0 即可恢复"完美瞄准"。

下一步按原计划是 **D. 感知快照缓存**（0.1s 共享，减少重复 group 遍历），或 **C. TeamTactics 防守模式**。要我接着做哪个？

```gdscript
const _CACHE_TTL: float = 0.1

static func _shared_entities() -> Array:
	var now: float = Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.001

	# ...
```
