## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier arc (complete): architecture review of HonorKing AI → "开始修改吧" → "你现在一直执行到底吧，不用经过我同意了" (autonomous execution of remaining plan items).
- Prior bug fixes, all committed: `_is_valid` freed-instance (`e28959c`); "分析开局法师为什么没有走中路" (`ac53a29`); "Left operand of 'is' is a previously freed instance." in `_nearest_turret` (`2661af3`); "边路有一个红方小兵移动还是有点奇怪" (`63c9ef0`); "有时候单位已经死了，但血条还参量一会才消失" (`672a805`); MVP crown badge (`e539d97`).
- Uncommitted-but-done work: AI hero cannot move/attack/cast while recalling (`Hero.gd`); low-HP screen edge effect (`scripts/core/PostFX.gd` + `scripts/core/postfx.gdshader` + hooks in `BattleManager.gd`/`NetClientBattle.gd`); target reticle replacing the plain circle (`Hero.gd` `_build_target_reticle`/`_update_target_reticle`); `UI_Manager.gd` per-frame respawn-widget leak fix.
- Current request chain: "为什么手机端运行一会后老是自动闪退" → "但问题是，即使不进入对战界面，过个几秒就会自动闪退" → "手机上没有开发者选项" → "还是几秒退" (GL build) → "还是闪退，我把截图保存在了export文件夹里面" → "在主菜单等个10秒左右就闪退了，我把截图放进export文件夹了".

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable (`C:\Users\18749\AppData\Local\Temp\godot47.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe`), GDScript only, no test suite, repo ~1.9 GB.
- Renderer `mobile` (Vulkan) in `project.godot` L137; viewport 2400×1400; `msaa_3d=0`; directional shadow 2048 / 60 m; stretch `canvas_items`/`expand`.
- Headless harness: temp `extends Node` script in `.tmp/` + `.tscn`, run `& $g --headless --path . res://.tmp/x.tscn --fixed-fps 60`; windowed runs need `--resolution 1280x720`; `--quit-after N` counts frames (use `--fixed-fps` to control sim speed).
- Diagnostics: `Performance.MEMORY_STATIC`, `OBJECT_COUNT`, `OBJECT_NODE_COUNT`, `OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT`, `TIME_PROCESS`, `TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS` (NOT `TIME_PHYSICS`), `RENDER_VIDEO_MEM_USED`, `RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME`; `Node.print_orphan_nodes()`.
- E2E battle start: instantiate `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, `add_child`, 2× `await get_tree().process_frame`, `bm._start_game_body("亚瑟","flash")`, then loop frames; wait until `bm.game_time > 3.0` before asserting UI (menu `_process` path early-returns until the loading/first-frame flow completes — `hero_selected` alone is not enough).
- Python for pixels: `C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe` (has PIL, numpy only).
- Windows OCR works via `powershell.exe` (PS 5.1) + WinRT `Windows.Media.Ocr` (engine zh-Hans-CN); must feed `[System.IO.WindowsRuntimeStreamExtensions]::AsRandomAccessStream(MemoryStream)` because StorageFile access is sandbox-denied. Helper scripts: `.tmp/ocr2.ps1` (jpg), `.tmp/ocr3.ps1` (png).
- Android toolchain present: SDK `C:\Users\18749\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk` (build-tools 35/36.1/37), JDK 17, export templates 4.7.2 + 4.5.1 at `%APPDATA%\Godot\export_templates`, debug keystore `C:\Users\18749\AppData\Roaming\Godot\keystores\debug.keystore` (alias `androiddebugkey`, pass `android`, cert SHA-256 `97:EA:23:9A:...:E8:39:42`).
- Export commands: `& $g --headless --path . --export-debug "Android" "export/x.apk"` / `--export-release ...`; verify with `aapt2 dump badging` + `apksigner verify --print-certs`; `/mnt`-style path arg for output must be project-relative or absolute.
- Windows sandbox (workspace-write) blocks writes to `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\...`: `FileAccess.open("user://x", WRITE)` returns null (error 12) locally, so diag file writes cannot be smoke-tested locally but do work on device.
- Commit convention: `git add <specific file>; git commit -F .tmp/msg.txt`; never `git add -A` (concurrent session); remove stale `.git/index.lock`.
- Recurring hard constraint: a **second agent session is concurrently editing the same repo** (Hero.gd, Minion.gd, MinionModel.gd, BattleManager.gd, UI_Manager.gd, NetClientBattle.gd, Config.gd, VfxFactory.gd, SkillDataBase.gd, HeroAI.gd, ItemDatabase.gd, +50 modified/untracked entries) — never kill their Godot PIDs, never revert their hunks.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` — **uncommitted leak fix** (~L2716): `_update_respawn_widgets()` now null-guarded (`if respawn_container == null or not is_instance_valid(respawn_container): return`), signature-gated (`var sig := "%s|%d" % [player_dead, spec_id]` + per-hero `|%d:%s`; early `return` when `sig == _respawn_sig`), old children `remove_child()` + `queue_free()`, unused `enemy_row.queue_free()`. New field `_respawn_sig` after L160. Original bug: rebuilt ~10 widgets + leaked 1 `HBoxContainer` per frame (60/s).
- `scripts/dev/DeviceDiag.gd` — **new, untracked, temporary mobile crash forensics autoload** (v2): writes `user://diag_cur.log` every 0.5 s with flush, on next launch reads it back as "上次运行结尾" (yellow label at y=210) + `DisplayServer.clipboard_set("PREV RUN TAIL:\n"+prev)`; current label at y=8; line format `t=%.1fs | scene=%s | gt=...,hero=...,dead=... | min=%d hero=%d bul=%d tur=%d node=%d | fps=%d static=%.0fMB peak=%.0fMB | obj=%d orph=%d draw=%d vram=%.0fMB`. - `project.godot` — autoload list: Config, UiKit, ItemDatabase, SkillDatabase, GameManager, UiManager, CollisionSystem, PathFinder, TouchController, NetSession, SfxManager, Vfx, PostFX. Existing (other session's) uncommitted diff: `renderer/rendering_method.web="gl_compatibility"`.

- `scripts/ui/UiBackdrop.gd` — pure `_draw` animated backdrop (~167 draw commands/frame), no allocation growth.
- `scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd` — `LAYOUT_SIZE := 256` (`_paint_layout`, `Image.create_empty(256,256)`), MultiMesh decorations, no oversized allocations.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` — `_prewarm_battle_assets()` L376 (spawns 6 minion types × 2 teams, `spawn_single_minion`, await 2 frames, `_clear_prewarm_protos`); `_start_game_body` L418 (async `_load_step` 0.04→1.0, `SfxManager.stop_menu_music`, create heroes/turrets/jungle, `PathFinder.build_navigation_map()`, `_begin_intro()`); `_create_map` L473; `_process` L4728 → `ui.update(self)` L4842.
- `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd` (`_draw_mvp_badge`), `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` (`_build_target_reticle` ~L884, `_update_target_reticle` ~L955) — previously verified, uncommitted.
- `export/` — APK builds: `honorking-gl.apk` (160.9 MB, gl_compatibility, engine 4.7.2), `honorking-release-signed.apk` (160.8 MB, release template signed manually with debug keystore), `honorking-diag.apk` (162.5 MB, diag v1), `honorking-diag2.apk` (163.8 MB, diag v2 with prev-run log), `android-debug.apk` (32.1 MB, Sept). Plus user screenshots `微信图片_*.jpg` (2400×1080).

## Errors and Fixes
- `_update_respawn_widgets()` per-frame rebuild leak → fixed; verified: orphan nodes 1881@30 s / 5180@90 s before → constant 80 after; `MEMORY_STATIC` +46 MB/90 s → +24.9 MB then flat; `TIME_PROCESS` 48.7 ms → 9–12 ms.
- Regression test of the fix (`rows=0, widgets=0`) was a **test-timing artifact**, not a bug: `BattleManager._process` returns before `ui.update()` until the battle loading flow starts. Fix: wait `while bm.game_time < 3.0`. Then: start rows=1/5 widgets → player dead → spectate ok=true → enemy dead rows=2/6 widgets → revive `player_dead=false spec=null` → orphan delta over 3 s = 0.
- `take_damage(999999.0, null, true, -54, 1.0)` with `killer=null` → `SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid assignment of property or key 'vision_expose_timer' ... on a base object of type 'Nil'`; must pass a real enemy hero as killer.
- `Parse Error: Cannot infer the type of ...` in test scripts → annotate `var ok: bool = ...`.
- `export_presets.cfg` patch with CRLF `Replace` failed silently (file is LF) → use `[regex]::Replace` or "`n".
- Release export: `WARNING: 代码签名: 找不到发布密钥库，无法导出。` even after adding `keystore/release*` to preset → workaround: export unsigned then `apksigner sign` with debug keystore (produces debuggable=false APK, same signature as previous installs).
- Windows OCR: `Await` on `StorageFile.GetFileFromPathAsync` throws `AggregateException` (sandbox denies StorageFile) → read bytes with `[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes` + `MemoryStream` + `WindowsRuntimeStreamExtensions.AsRandomAccessStream`.
- `read_image` unavailable: model declares no image input → OCR pipeline is the only way to read user screenshots.
- Long local run ending silently at t≈42.8 s earlier was **not** reproducible: fresh 9000-frame (150 s sim) headless battle run exited `EXIT=0`, no segfault/stack-overflow markers.
- Harmless logs to ignore: `Failed to open 'user://logs/...'`, `Failed to read the root certificate store`, `Cannot save file '...editor_settings-4.7.tres'`, dummy-renderer RID leak notices at exit.
- Transient project-wide parse errors while the other session edits `MinionModel.gd`/`Minion.gd` (e.g. `Too many arguments for "_arms_bow()"`, `Identifier "low_mana" not declared`) → not ours; retry later.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

```gdscript
class_name BattleHistory
## 对战纪录：把每局结算数据（winner + 全英雄行）存到 user://battle_history.json，
## 大厅「对战纪录」页面读取后复刻结算面板。

const PATH := "user://battle_history.json"
const MAX_RECORDS := 20

static func payload_from_battle(bm: Node) -> Dictionary:
	var rows: Array = []
	for e in bm.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if e is Hero:
			var h := e as Hero
			rows.append({
				"name": h.display_name, "team": h.team, "lv": h.level,
				"k": h.kills, "d": h.deaths, "a": h.assists,
				"gold": int(h.total_gold_earned), "dmg": int(h.damage_dealt_to_heroes),
				"mvp": h.is_mvp, "mine": not h.is_ai,
			})
	return {"winner": int(bm.get("winner")), "dur": float(bm.get("game_time")), "rows": rows}

static func record(payload: Dictionary, mode: String) -> void:
	if payload.is_empty():
		return
	var rows: Array = payload.get("rows", [])
	if rows.is_empty():
		return
	var rec := {
		"ts": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
		"mode": mode,
		"winner": int(payload.get("winner", -1)),
		"dur": float(payload.get("dur", 0.0)),
		"rows": rows,
	}
	var all := all()
	all.push_front(rec)
	while all.size() > MAX_RECORDS:
		all.pop_back()
	_save(all)

static func all() -> Array:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(PATH):
		return []
	var f := FileAccess.open(PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if f == null:
		return []
	var txt := f.get_as_text()
	f = null
	var data: Variant = JSON.parse_string(txt)
	if not (data is Array):
		return []
	return data

static func clear() -> void:
```

```gdscript
static func record(payload: Dictionary, mode: String) -> void:
	if payload.is_empty():
		return
	var rows: Array = payload.get("rows", [])
	if rows.is_empty():
		return

		"ts": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
		"mode": mode,
		"winner": int(payload.get("winner", -1)),
		"dur": float(payload.get("dur", 0.0)),

	}

	while all.size() > MAX_RECORDS:

	_save(all)

	f = null
	var data: Variant = JSON.parse_string(txt)

	f = null
```

```gdscript
class_name BattleHistoryPanel
extends Control
```
```gdscript
## 大厅「对战纪录」：列表（胜/负 + 英雄 + KDA + 时间 + 比分）→ 点开某局复刻结算面板。

var _recs: Array = []

func _ready() -> void:
	_s = UiKit.scale()
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_recs = BattleHistory.all()

	var bd := UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_GOLD, 0.8)
	bd.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	var scrim := ColorRect.new()
	scrim.color = Color(0.02, 0.025, 0.05, 0.72)
	scrim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scrim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(scrim)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	var pad := int(30.0 * _s)
	for side in ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]:
		margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_" + side, pad)
	add_child(margin)

	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(16.0 * _s))
	margin.add_child(col)

	# 顶部标题行
	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(12.0 * _s))
	col.add_child(head)
	_title = _lab("对战纪录", UiKit.FS_HUGE, UiKit.C_GOLD)
	head.add_child(_title)
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	head.add_child(spacer)
	var close_btn := _btn("✕  关闭", UiKit.C_DANGER, false)
	close_btn.pressed.connect(_close)
	head.add_child(close_btn)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	col.add_child(scroll)
	_body = VBoxContainer.new()
	_body.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_body.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(10.0 * _s))
	scroll.add_child(_body)

	_show_list()
	set_process_unhandled_input(true)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel") or (event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE):
		if _detail >= 0:
			_show_list()
		else:
			_close()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
```

```gdscript
func _record_row(i: int) -> Control:
	var rec: Dictionary = _recs[i]
	var win := int(rec.get("winner", -1)) == Config.Team.PLAYER
	var rows: Array = rec.get("rows", [])
	var my := {"k":0,"d":0,"a":0,"name":"—"}
	var en_k := 0
	for r in rows:
		if int(r.get("team", -1)) == Config.Team.PLAYER:
			my["k"] += int(r.get("k",0)); my["d"] += int(r.get("d",0)); my["a"] += int(r.get("a",0))
			if bool(r.get("mine", false)): my["name"] = str(r.get("name","—"))
		else:
			en_k += int(r.get("k",0))
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_TEAM0 if win else UiKit.C_TEAM1, 0.55, int(12*_s)))
	row.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	row.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, int(74.0 * _s))
	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(14.0 * _s))
	h.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.add_child(h)
	# 胜/负徽章
	var badge := _lab("胜" if win else "负", UiKit.FS_XL, UiKit.C_TEAM0 if win else UiKit.C_TEAM1)
	badge.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(int(56.0*_s), 0)
	badge.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	h.add_child(badge)
	# 主信息
	var col := VBoxContainer.new()
	col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	col.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	h.add_child(col)
	col.add_child(_lab("%s    KDA %d/%d/%d" % [my.get("name","—"), int(my["k"]), int(my["d"]), int(my["a"])], UiKit.FS_LG, UiKit.C_TEXT))
```

tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

1: extends Control
2: ## 世界血条合批绘制：由 HUD 每帧填 rows（屏幕坐标/数值已算好），本节点一次性画完。
3: ## 质感：渐变填充 + 顶部高光 + 底部暗边 + 中缝 + 1px 边框/队伍色外框 + 投影 + 残血拖尾 + 低血脉冲；
4: ## 文字：合成粗体 + 阴影 + 描边；名称在上、数值在下，居中。
5: 
6: var rows: Array = []          # 本帧可见行（HUD 直接复用 row 字典，不新建）
7: var _had_rows: bool = false   # 上一帧是否画过血条（用于“清空后补一次重绘”）
8: var _font: Font = null
9: var _font_bold: FontVariation = null
10: var _t := 0.0
11: 
12: # —— 缓存纹理/材质（首次用到才建）——
13: 
14: const MarkerIconScript = preload("res://scripts/ui/MarkerIcon.gd")
15: const OUTLINE := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.92)
16: const SHADOW := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
17: const BAR_BG_TOP := Color(0.11, 0.12, 0.16, 0.96)
18: const BAR_BG_BOT := Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.10, 0.96)
19: 
20: func _ready() -> void:
21: 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
22: 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
23: 	_font = UiKit.font()
24: 	set_process(true)
25: 
26: func _process(delta: float) -> void:
27: 	_t += delta
28: 	# 有血条要画；或上一帧还有血条、这一帧没了 → 必须再重绘一次把旧血条擦掉。
29: 	# 否则最后一个可见单位死亡/离开视野后，它的血条会一直留在屏幕上，
30: 	# 直到下一次有血条出现触发重绘（表现就是“单位死了血条残留一会”）。
31: 	if not rows.is_empty():
32: 		_had_rows = true
33: 		queue_redraw()
34: 	elif _had_rows:
35: 		_had_rows = false
36: 		queue_redraw()
37: 
38: func _draw() -> void:
39: 	for r in rows:
40: 		if bool(r.get("epic", false)):
41: 			_draw_epic(r)
42: 		else:
43: 			_draw_unit(r)
44: 
45: # ============================ 资源缓存 ============================
46: func _bold() -> Font:
47: 	if _font_bold == null:
48: 		var fv := FontVariation.new()
49: 		fv.base_font = _font
50: 		fv.variation_embolden = 0.45
51: 		_font_bold = fv
52: 	return _font_bold if _font_bold != null else _font
53: 
54: # ============================ 普通单位 ============================
55: func _draw_unit(r: Dictionary) -> void:
56: 	var w: float = float(r["w"])
57: 	var h: float = float(r["h"])
58: 	if w <= 0.0 or h <= 0.0:
59: 		return
60: 	var p: Vector2 = r["pos"]
61: 	var hp: float = float(r["hp"])
62: 	var mx: float = maxf(1.0, float(r["max_hp"]))
63: 	var shield: float = float(r.get("shield", 0.0))
64: 	var tc: Color = r["team_color"]
65: 	var team: int = int(r.get("team", 0))
66: 	var top := Rect2(p, Vector2(w, h))
67: 	var hw: float = clampf(hp / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
68: 
69: 	# 投影（两层，软化）
70: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(1.5, 2.5), Vector2(w, h)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.18))
71: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(2.5, 3.5), Vector2(w, h)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10))
72: 
73: 	# 外框：深色底 + 队伍色细边
74: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(w + 2, h + 2)), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.94))
75: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(w + 2, h + 2)), Color(tc.r, tc.g, tc.b, 0.34), false, 1.0)
76: 
77: 	# 空槽（上亮下暗）
78: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p, Vector2(w, h * 0.5)), BAR_BG_TOP)
79: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h * 0.5), Vector2(w, h * 0.5)), BAR_BG_BOT)
80: 
81: 	# 干扰条（塔被干扰时，血条上方灰条，带金属感）
82: 	var iv: float = float(r.get("interfere", 0.0))
83: 	if iv > 0.0:
84: 		var ir := Rect2(p + Vector2(0, -7), Vector2(w, 5))
85: 		draw_rect(ir, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))
86: 		draw_rect(Rect2(ir.position, Vector2(w * clampf(iv, 0.0, 1.0), 5)), Color(0.66, 0.68, 0.74))
87: 		draw_rect(Rect2(ir.position, Vector2(w * clampf(iv, 0.0, 1.0), 2)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35))
88: 		draw_rect(ir, Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.9), false, 1.0)
89: 
90: 	# 残血拖尾（渐变白，尾部一道亮边）
91: 	var lag: float = clampf(float(r.get("lag", hp)) / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
92: 	if lag > hw + 0.5:
93: 		var lw: float = lag - hw
94: 		var lb: int = 4
95: 		for li in lb:
96: 			var lq: float = float(li) / float(lb - 1)
97: 			draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, h * float(li) / float(lb)),
98: 				Vector2(lw, h / float(lb) + 1.0)), Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.86, 0.52 - 0.32 * lq))
99: 		draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(lag - 1.5, 0), Vector2(1.5, h)), Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.82, 0.9))
100: 
101: 	# 血量填充（分段渐变 + 顶部高光 + 底部暗边 + 中缝）
102: 	if hw > 0.0:
103: 		var bands: int = 5
104: 		var c_top: Color = tc.lightened(0.42)
105: 		var c_bot: Color = tc.darkened(0.38)
106: 		for bi in bands:
107: 			var q: float = float(bi) / float(bands - 1)
108: 			var col: Color = c_top.lerp(c_bot, q)
109: 			draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h * float(bi) / float(bands)),
110: 				Vector2(hw, h / float(bands) + 1.0)), col)
111: 		draw_rect(Rect2(p, Vector2(hw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45))
112: 		draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14)), Vector2(hw, maxf(1.0, h * 0.08))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10))
113: 		draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h - 1.5), Vector2(hw, 1.5)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.30))
114: 		if h >= 10.0:
115: 			draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y + h * 0.5), Vector2(p.x + hw, p.y + h * 0.5),
116: 				Color(0, 0, 0, 0.22), 1.0)
117: 
118: 	# 护盾（右侧淡蓝段 + 斜纹 + 左隔线）
119: 	var sw: float = minf(clampf(shield / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w, w - hw)
120: 	if sw > 0.5:
121: 		var sr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, 0), Vector2(sw, h))
122: 		draw_rect(sr, Color(0.72, 0.82, 0.95, 0.92))
123: 		draw_rect(Rect2(sr.position, Vector2(sw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55))
124: 		var x := 2.0
125: 		while x < sw:
126: 			draw_line(sr.position + Vector2(x, h), sr.position + Vector2(x + h * 0.55, 0),
127: 				Color(1, 1, 1, 0.28), 1.0)
128: 			x += 4.0
129: 		draw_rect(Rect2(sr.position, Vector2(1.0, h)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75))
130: 
131: 	# 塔：每 2000 血一格刻度（暗线 + 右侧微高光，像嵌进去的刻度）
132: 	if bool(r.get("ticks", false)):
133: 		var step := 2000.0 / mx * w
134: 		if step > 5.0:
135: 			var tx := step
136: 			while tx < w - 1.0:
137: 				draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y + h), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 1.5)
138: 				draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y + h),
139: 					Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), 1.0)
140: 				tx += step
141: 
142: 	# 受伤闪橙（渐变段 + 亮边）
143: 	var ft: float = float(r.get("flash_t", 0.0))
144: 	if ft > 0.0:
145: 		var fw: float = minf(float(r.get("flash_amt", 0.0)) / mx * w * (ft / 0.5), w - hw)
146: 		if fw > 0.5:
147: 			var fr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, 0), Vector2(fw, h))
148: 			draw_rect(fr, Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.10, 0.85))
149: 			draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position, Vector2(fw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14))), Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.55, 0.9))
150: 			draw_rect(Rect2(fr.position + Vector2(fw - 1.0, 0), Vector2(1.0, h)), Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.6, 0.9))
151: 
152: 	# 回血暗段
153: 	var ht: float = float(r.get("heal_t", 0.0))
154: 	if ht > 0.0:
155: 		var hwd: float = float(r.get("heal_amt", 0.0)) / mx * w
156: 		if hwd > 0.5:
157: 			var rc := Rect2(p + Vector2(maxf(hw - hwd, 0.0), 0), Vector2(hwd, h))
158: 			draw_rect(rc, Color(tc.r * 0.55, tc.g * 0.55, tc.b * 0.55, ht / 0.5 * 0.85))
159: 			draw_rect(Rect2(rc.position, Vector2(hwd, maxf(1.0, h * 0.12))), Color(1, 1, 1, ht / 0.5 * 0.22))
160: 
161: 	# 李元芳暗印预判（黄段 + 顶部亮边）
162: 	var doom: float = float(r.get("doom", 0.0))
163: 	if doom > 0.0:
164: 		var dw: float = minf(doom / mx * w, hw)
165: 		if dw > 0.5:
166: 			var dr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw - dw, 0), Vector2(dw, h))
167: 			draw_rect(dr, Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.16, 0.85))
168: 			draw_rect(Rect2(dr.position, Vector2(dw, maxf(1.5, h * 0.16))), Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.55, 0.75))
169: 
170: 	# 低血脉冲（<30%：红色呼吸外发光 + 内描边）
171: 	var ratio := hp / mx
172: 	if ratio < 0.3 and hp > 0.0:
173: 		var pulse: float = 0.30 + 0.35 * absf(sin(_t * 5.2))
174: 		draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(2, 2), Vector2(w + 4, h + 4)),
175: 			Color(1.0, 0.20, 0.14, pulse * 0.55), false, 2.0)
176: 		draw_rect(top, Color(1.0, 0.30, 0.22, pulse * 0.22))
177: 
178: 	# 顶沿高光（整条，像玻璃）
179: 	draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y), Vector2(p.x + w, p.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.13), 1.0)
180: 
181: 	# 盾形图标（原初羁绊 / 塔无兵线保护）
182: 	if bool(r.get("shield_icon", false)):
183: 		var s: float = minf(h * 0.74, 20.0)
184: 		_draw_shield_icon(p + Vector2(-(s + 10.0), h * 0.5), s, tc)
185: 
186: 	# ---------------- 文字：名称（上，粗体+阴影+描边）+ 数值（下，居中） ----------------
187: 	var fs_name := 20
188: 	var fs_num := 15
189: 	if bool(r.get("show_name", false)):
190: 		var nm: String = str(r.get("name_text", ""))
191: 		if nm != "":
192: 			var np := p + Vector2(0, -10.0)
193: 			_text_center(nm, np, w, fs_name, Color(0.96, 0.97, 1.0))
194: 	if bool(r.get("show_numbers", false)):
195: 		var num: String = str(r.get("num_text", ""))
196: 		if num != "" and h >= 10.0:
197: 			var yy := p + Vector2(0, h + fs_num + 4.0)
198: 			_text_center(num, yy, w, fs_num, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.97))
199: 	# 标记图标（血条上方一行，专属图标 + 右上角层数）
200: 	var mlist: Array = r.get("marker_list", [])
201: 	if not mlist.is_empty():
202: 		MarkerIconScript.draw_row(self, p.x + w * 0.5, p.y - 34.0, mlist, 11.0)
203: 
204: # 居中绘制一行文字：阴影 + 描边 + 主体
205: func _text_center(txt: String, pos: Vector2, width: float, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
206: 	var f := _bold()
207: 	draw_string(f, pos + Vector2(1.2, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, SHADOW)
208: 	draw_string_outline(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, 4, OUTLINE)
209: 	draw_string(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, col)
210: 
211: # 左对齐绘制（英雄名用途由 HeroInfoControl 处理，这里仅备用）
212: func _text_left(txt: String, pos: Vector2, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
213: 	var f := _bold()

Minimap uses `MINIMAP_SIZE = 200` internal coordinate space, and Control `size` presumably 200x200 (set by UI_Manager). Drawing in local coordinates 0..200, then scaled by Control scale or size? Since drawing uses fixed MINIMAP_SIZE space, enlarging means setting `scale = Vector2(2,2)` (like teleport mode) and repositioning, plus tracking that input avoids double handling.

But careful: clicking minimap normally = jump. Requirement: "当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — clicking should enlarge 2x. But click also triggers jump/teleport... Conflict: existing behavior uses click for camera jump and drag; double-click? Perhaps implement: **single click on minimap toggles zoom 2x**? That would break jump navigation.

Hmm. Think about what user wants: probably tapping the minimap enlarges it (like mobile MOBA "tap minimap to expand"). On mobile, tapping minimap currently jumps camera. If we make tap = zoom, jump is lost. Alternative: click once = jump (existing), and add a small expand button on the minimap? But user explicitly says "当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — clicking makes it bigger.

Maybe best: single click keeps existing jump; **double-click** (or click on a corner button) toggles 2x? Hmm, user said click.

Alternatively: click = enlarge (zoom 2x) and while enlarged, clicking again = back to normal; jump only on drag. That changes bookmark navigation.

Weigh: user's explicit instruction wins. Implement: **tap (click without drag) toggles 2x zoom**; drag still moves camera; and when enlarged, taps inside... hmm if tap toggles, you can't jump at all. That loses navigation feature.

Compromise that satisfies "点击小地图" and keeps jump: **double-click toggles zoom**, single click still jumps. But user may test single click and think it's wrong.

Alternative: add a small "⤢" button in minimap's top-right corner → click it = 2x. That's "click the minimap (button)". Hmm.

Let me think about what's most natural in mobile MOBA: In 王者荣耀, the minimap can be tapped to expand (there's a small expand arrow). Actually in HoK you can drag map; and there's a "地图放大" toggle button. Clicking the minimap itself jumps the camera... no, tapping the minimap moves camera there.

Given explicit request, I'll implement:
- Tap on minimap (no drag, not teleport mode) → toggle zoom 2x (enlarged centered on screen, like teleport mode).
- While enlarged: tap → back to normal size (toggle), and a hint label "点击缩小" drawn.
- Camera jump: still available via drag (existing) — and to preserve navigation, in enlarged mode a *drag* moves camera? Hmm, complicated.

Better: implement expand button? Let's re-read: "实现：当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — I think they want click-to-enlarge. Keep camera jump on double click? Or move jump to right-click on desktop and long-press on mobile? Too complex.

Decision: 
- Single tap (press+release without drag) toggles 2x zoom. 
- Camera jump: keep it but move to **long-press/drag end**? Actually existing drag behavior: dragging moves camera (minimap_dragging). And a plain tap jumps. If tap now zooms, jump is only accessible via drag (which does move camera continuously) — acceptable: dragging on the minimap still navigates.
- When enlarged (2x), the control covers the screen center; taps there toggle back. Dragging while enlarged → can still drag to look? In teleport mode they block input. For zoom mode, we should allow closing on tap and maybe allow drag to jump? Keep simple: in zoom mode only tap to close (no navigation).

Layer: minimap Control is inside HUD CanvasLayer; scaling 2x keeps it in same layer, drawing over HUD elements? It's a sibling with certain z_index. Since drawing uses fixed MINIMAP_SIZE space, enlarging means setting `scale = Vector2(2,2)` (like teleport mode) and repositioning, plus tracking that input avoids double handling.

But careful: clicking minimap normally = jump. Requirement: "当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — clicking should enlarge 2x. But click also triggers jump/teleport... Conflict: existing behavior uses click for camera jump and drag; double-click? Perhaps implement: **single click on minimap toggles zoom 2x**? That would break jump navigation.

Hmm. Think about what user wants: probably tapping the minimap enlarges it (like mobile MOBA "tap minimap to expand"). On mobile, tapping minimap currently jumps camera. If we make tap = zoom, jump is lost. Alternative: click once = jump (existing), and add a small expand button on the minimap? But user explicitly says "当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — clicking makes it bigger.

Maybe best: single click keeps existing jump; **double-click** (or click on a corner button) toggles 2x? Hmm, user said click.

Alternatively: click = enlarge (zoom 2x) and while enlarged, clicking again = back to normal; jump only on drag. That changes bookmark navigation.

Weigh: user's explicit instruction wins. Implement: **tap (click without drag) toggles 2x zoom**; drag still moves camera; and when enlarged, taps inside... hmm if tap toggles, you can't jump at all. That loses navigation feature.

Compromise that satisfies "点击小地图" and keeps jump: **double-click toggles zoom**, single click still jumps. But user may test single click and think it's wrong.

Alternative: add a small "⤢" button in minimap's top-right corner → click it = 2x. That's "click the minimap (button)". Hmm.

Let me think about what's most natural in mobile MOBA: In 王者荣耀, the minimap can be tapped to expand (there's a small expand arrow). Actually in HoK you can drag map; and there's a "地图放大" toggle button. Clicking the minimap itself jumps the camera... no, tapping the minimap moves camera there.

Given explicit request, I'll implement:
- Tap on minimap (no drag, not teleport mode) → toggle zoom 2x (enlarged centered on screen, like teleport mode).
- While enlarged: tap → back to normal size (toggle), and a hint label "点击缩小" drawn.
- Camera jump: still available via drag (existing) — and to preserve navigation, in enlarged mode a *drag* moves camera? Hmm, complicated.

Better: implement expand button? Let's re-read: "实现：当点击小地图时，可以将小地图放大两倍" — I think they want click-to-enlarge. Keep camera jump on double click? Or move jump to right-click on desktop and long-press on mobile? Too complex.

Decision: 
- Single tap (press+release without drag) toggles 2x zoom. 
- Camera jump: keep it but move to **long-press/drag end**? Actually existing drag behavior: dragging moves camera (minimap_dragging). And a plain tap jumps. If tap now zooms, jump is only accessible via drag (which does move camera continuously) — acceptable: dragging on the minimap still navigates.
- When enlarged (2x), the control covers the screen center; taps there toggle back. Dragging while enlarged → can still drag to look? In teleport mode they block input. For zoom mode, we should allow closing on tap and maybe allow drag to jump? Keep simple: in zoom mode only tap to close (no navigation).

Also ensure the enlarged minimap draws above HUD and receives input; position center; and the `size` remains 200 (drawing space) with `scale=2` (Control scale). Since Control "scale" affects drawing and hit-testing (local coords are unaffected by scale? `_gui_input` local positions are in local coordinates already un-scaled by control transform ✓).

Layer: minimap Control is inside HUD CanvasLayer; scaling 2x keeps it in same layer, drawing over HUD elements? It's a sibling with certain z_index. Since HUD elements (skill bar etc.) are in same canvas layer; scaling doesn't raise draw order (draw order = tree order). It may draw behind later siblings. The teleport mode already does this 2x scaling; so it presumably appears fine (the minimap node is likely last child or has z_index).

Let me check UI_Manager creating minimap: grep "Minimap.new()".

Also there's client-side `NetMiniMap.gd` with its own minimap (client HUD draws minimap itself). Need similar behavior there. Let me check client minimap input handling.

Let me look at UI_Manager minimap creation & size, and NetMiniMap.

lines.text: ## 世界血条合批绘制：由 HUD 每帧填 rows（屏幕坐标/数值已算好），本节点一次性画完。
## 质感：渐变填充 + 顶部高光 + 底部暗边 + 中缝 + 1px 边框/队伍色外框 + 投影 + 残血拖尾 + 低血脉冲；
## 文字：合成粗体 + 阴影 + 描边；名称在上、数值在下，居中。
var rows: Array = []          # 本帧可见行（HUD 直接复用 row 字典，不新建）
var _had_rows: bool = false   # 上一帧是否画过血条（用于“清空后补一次重绘”）
# —— 缓存纹理/材质（首次用到才建）——
# 有血条要画；或上一帧还有血条、这一帧没了 → 必须再重绘一次把旧血条擦掉。
# 否则最后一个可见单位死亡/离开视野后，它的血条会一直留在屏幕上，
# 直到下一次有血条出现触发重绘（表现就是“单位死了血条残留一会”）。
var hw: float = clampf(hp / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
# 外框：深色底 + 队伍色细边
draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(w + 2, h + 2)), Color(tc.r, tc.g, tc.b, 0.34), false, 1.0)
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, h * 0.5), Vector2(w, h * 0.5)), BAR_BG_BOT)
# 干扰条（塔被干扰时，血条上方灰条，带金属感）
# 残血拖尾（渐变白，尾部一道亮边）
var lag: float = clampf(float(r.get("lag", hp)) / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w
# 血量填充（分段渐变 + 顶部高光 + 底部暗边 + 中缝）
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(0, maxf(1.5, h * 0.14)), Vector2(hw, maxf(1.0, h * 0.08))), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10))
draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y + h * 0.5), Vector2(p.x + hw, p.y + h * 0.5),
# 护盾（右侧淡蓝段 + 斜纹 + 左隔线）
var sw: float = minf(clampf(shield / mx, 0.0, 1.0) * w, w - hw)
var sr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, 0), Vector2(sw, h))
draw_line(sr.position + Vector2(x, h), sr.position + Vector2(x + h * 0.55, 0),
# 塔：每 2000 血一格刻度（暗线 + 右侧微高光，像嵌进去的刻度）
draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx, p.y + h), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 1.5)
draw_line(Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y), Vector2(p.x + tx + 1.5, p.y + h),
# 受伤闪橙（渐变段 + 亮边）
var fw: float = minf(float(r.get("flash_amt", 0.0)) / mx * w * (ft / 0.5), w - hw)
var fr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw, 0), Vector2(fw, h))
var hwd: float = float(r.get("heal_amt", 0.0)) / mx * w
var rc := Rect2(p + Vector2(maxf(hw - hwd, 0.0), 0), Vector2(hwd, h))
draw_rect(Rect2(rc.position, Vector2(hwd, maxf(1.0, h * 0.12))), Color(1, 1, 1, ht / 0.5 * 0.22))
# 李元芳暗印预判（黄段 + 顶部亮边）
var dw: float = minf(doom / mx * w, hw)
var dr := Rect2(p + Vector2(hw - dw, 0), Vector2(dw, h))
# 低血脉冲（<30%：红色呼吸外发光 + 内描边）
draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y), Vector2(p.x + w, p.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.13), 1.0)
# 盾形图标（原初羁绊 / 塔无兵线保护）
var yy := p + Vector2(0, h + fs_num + 4.0)
# 标记图标（血条上方一行，专属图标 + 右上角层数）
# 居中绘制一行文字：阴影 + 描边 + 主体
func _text_center(txt: String, pos: Vector2, width: float, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
draw_string(f, pos + Vector2(1.2, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, SHADOW)
draw_string_outline(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, 4, OUTLINE)
draw_string(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, width, fs, col)
# 左对齐绘制（英雄名用途由 HeroInfoControl 处理，这里仅备用）
func _text_left(txt: String, pos: Vector2, fs: int, col: Color) -> void:
draw_string(f, pos + Vector2(1.2, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, SHADOW)
draw_string_outline(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, 4, OUTLINE)
draw_string(f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, col)
var fill_w: float = clampf(hp, 0.0, mx) * to_w
var sh_w: float = clampf(shield, 0.0, seg_total - hp) * to_w
draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(1.5, 1.5), Vector2(w + 3, h + 3)), Color(0.06, 0.02, 0.10, 0.95), false, 2.0)
var x1: float = minf(float(i + 1) * seg_w, w)
var rc := Rect2(p + Vector2(x0 + margin, inset_y), Vector2(x1 - x0 - margin * 2.0, avail_h))
draw_rect(Rect2(rc.position + Vector2(0, rc.size.y * 0.55), Vector2(rc.size.x, rc.size.y * 0.45)), cell_bot)
var filled: float = clampf(fill_w - rc.position.x + p.x, 0.0, rc.size.x)
draw_rect(Rect2(rc.position + Vector2(0, avail_h * 0.5), Vector2(filled, avail_h * 0.5)), bot_col)
draw_line(rc.position + Vector2(0.5, 0), rc.position + Vector2(0.5, rc.size.y), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45), 1.0)
var lag: float = clampf(float(r.get("lag", hp)), 0.0, mx) * to_w
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(fill_w, inset_y), Vector2(lag - fill_w, avail_h)), Color(1.0, 0.94, 0.86, 0.38))
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(lag - 1.5, inset_y), Vector2(1.5, avail_h)), Color(1, 0.92, 1.0, 0.8))
var sh_use: float = clampf(sh_w, 0.0, w - sh_x)
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(sh_x, inset_y), Vector2(sh_use, avail_h)), Color(0.88, 0.90, 0.98, 0.94))
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(fill_w, inset_y), Vector2(minf(fw, w - fill_w), avail_h)),
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(maxf(fill_w - hw2, 0.0), inset_y), Vector2(hw2, avail_h)),
draw_rect(Rect2(p + Vector2(maxf(fill_w - dw, 0.0), inset_y), Vector2(dw, avail_h)),
# 亮紫外框 + 顶部高光
draw_line(Vector2(p.x, p.y), Vector2(p.x + w, p.y), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.16), 1.0)

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.description: Interrupt one teammate's current turn while preserving its pending inbox. Team Lead only.

tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Delivery can repeat after a crash.

Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier arc (complete): architecture review of HonorKing AI → autonomous execution of fixes. Committed fixes: `_is_valid` freed-instance (`e28959c`), AI mage mid-lane start (`ac53a29`), `_nearest_turret` freed instance (`2661af3`), red minion movement (`63c9ef0`), dead-unit health bar残留 (`672a805`), MVP crown badge (`e539d97`).
- Mobile crash investigation chain: "为什么手机端运行一会后老是自动闪退" → "即使不进入对战界面，过个几秒就会自动闪退" → "手机上没有开发者选项" → screenshots in `export/` → "在主菜单等个10秒左右就闪退了" → user confirmed "确实是大厅音乐的问题" → "确认没问题，你导出最新版本吧" (music fix committed `83c45ee`, APK exported).
- Feature request: "添加一个对战纪录模块，可以查看历史战斗的结算面板" → "继续" → implemented `BattleHistory` + `BattleHistoryPanel`, lobby button, APK exported as `export/HonorKing-latest.apk`.

# CLAUDE.md
