- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

524: 		(col.r * a + dst.r * dst.a * (1.0 - a)) / out_a,

		var px := int(round(fs * rs))

class ValuePopup extends Control:
	# 战场漂浮数值（金币/治疗）：矢量图标 + 数值，全部 draw_* 绘制（引擎字体无这些字形）
	var text := ""
	var icon := "coin"          # coin / sword / cross
	var col := Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.35)
	var rs := 1.0
	var fs := 34
	func setup(txt: String, icon_kind: String, color: Color, scale: float, font_size: int = 34) -> void:
		text = txt
		icon = icon_kind
		col = color
		rs = scale
		fs = font_size
		var m := measure()
		custom_minimum_size = m
		size = m
		mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		queue_redraw()
	func measure() -> Vector2:
		var font: Font = UiKit.font()
		var px := int(round(fs * rs))
		var asc := font.get_ascent(px)
		var desc := font.get_descent(px)
		var tw := font.get_string_size(text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, px).x
		return Vector2(_icon_w() + round(8 * rs) + tw, maxf(asc + desc, _icon_w() * 1.1))
	func _icon_w() -> float:
		return round((26 if icon == "cross" else 30) * rs)
	func _draw():
		var font: Font = UiKit.font()
		var px := int(round(fs * rs))
		var asc := font.get_ascent(px)
		var desc := font.get_descent(px)
		var ic_w := _icon_w()
		var ic := Vector2(ic_w * 0.5, size.y * 0.5)
		match icon:
			"sword": _draw_sword(ic, ic_w, col)
			"cross": _draw_cross(ic, ic_w, col)
			_: _draw_coin(ic, ic_w, col)
		var x0 := ic_w + round(8 * rs)
		var baseline := size.y * 0.5 - (asc + desc) * 0.5 + asc
		draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(x0, baseline), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, px, maxi(2, int(round(px * 0.22))), Color(0.10, 0.06, 0.02, 0.95))
		draw_string(font, Vector2(x0, baseline), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, px, col)
	func _draw_sword(c: Vector2, w: float, gold: Color) -> void: ... (original)
	func _draw_cross(c: Vector2, w: float, col: Color) -> void:
		var k := w * 0.30
		draw_line(c + Vector2(-k, 0), c + Vector2(k, 0), col, maxf(2.0, k * 0.55))
		draw_line(c + Vector2(0, -k), c + Vector2(0, k), col, maxf(2.0, k * 0.55))
	func _draw_coin(c: Vector2, w: float, gold: Color) -> void:
		var r := w * 0.38
		draw_circle(c + Vector2(0.6, 1.0), r, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))   # 投影
		draw_circle(c, r, gold.darkened(0.18))
		draw_circle(c, r * 0.86, gold)
		draw_circle(c, r * 0.52, gold.darkened(0.30))
		draw_arc(c, r * 0.86, PI * 1.12, PI * 1.62, 12, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55), maxf(1.0, r * 0.16))

两项都实现了（按你说的没有导出 APK）。

## 1. 轻点小地图 → 放大 2 倍

`scripts/ui/MiniMap.gd`（单机/主机）和 `scripts/net/NetMiniMap.gd`（联机客户端）都加了同一套交互：

- **常态轻点**：小地图以 `scale=2` 放大并居中到屏幕中央（复用原有传送模式的缩放做法），同时升起 `z_index` 盖住同层元素
- **放大态轻点**：相机跳转到点击位置并自动收起（保留了原来的地图跳转能力，只是变成"先放大、再点目的地"两步）
- **放大态拖动**：仍然是平移取景；**再点放大态**也不会卡住，位置/缩放/层级都精确还原
- 放大时额外画**金色描边 + 底部操作提示条**（「轻点跳转 · 拖动平移 · 再点收起」），避免玩家不知道怎么退出
- 站在传送阵上点小地图时，依旧优先进入传送模式（原逻辑不变）

## 2. 战场弹出数字美化

`scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`（主机）+ `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`（客户端）同步改：

**伤害数字**
- 三种配色区分：物理=暖橙、法术=品紫、暴击=亮金（描边跟着换深色，暴击用深棕描边避免糊成一圈）
- 加**柔和投影**（数值从杂乱战场背景里托出来）+ 描边随字号缩放（16→60px 都有合适粗细）
- 新增**弹入动画**：数字先放大 1.45 倍再 `TRANS_BACK` 回弹到 1.0（暴击弹得更狠、上浮更高），之后立方缓出上浮 + 淡出；暴击四芒星图标位置改为按实际数字高度精确居中

**金币弹出**：原来的 `KillGoldPopup` 升级为通用 `ValuePopup`——左侧矢量徽标 + 数值，自己击杀=**金色小剑 + 34 号字**，助攻/自然金币=**金币徽标（金环+亮面+高光弧）+ 30 号字**，同样带弹入 + 上浮淡出（客户端补了 `_CoinMark`，两端一致）

**治疗数字**：纯绿字改为**绿色十字徽标 + 数值**，和伤害数字一眼区分，弹入/上浮更快更轻

## 验证

- 战斗内实际调用 5 种弹出（普通/暴击伤害、金币 2 种、治疗）：尺寸正常（26×30 / 95×73 / 181×55 / 196×62 / 113×48），无脚本错误
- SubViewport 离屏渲染 + 逐像素统计：金币金像素 621、小剑金色 153、治疗绿色 396、文字亮色 1168 → 三种徽标都真实画出来了
- 小地图：模拟轻点 → `zoomed=true, scale=(2,2), 居中`；再点 → `zoomed=false, scale/位置精确还原 + 触发跳转`；主机与客户端两条路径都通过

`scripts/ui/MiniMap.gd`（单机/主机）和 `scripts/net/NetMiniMap.gd`（联机客户端）都加了同一套交互：

- **常态轻点**：小地图以 `scale=2` 放大并居中到屏幕中央（复用原有传送模式的缩放做法），同时升起 `z_index` 盖住同层元素
- **放大态轻点**：相机跳转到点击位置并自动收起（保留了原来的地图跳转能力，只是变成"先放大、再点目的地"两步）
- **放大态拖动**：仍然是平移取景；**再点放大态**也不会卡住，位置/缩放/层级都精确还原
- 放大时额外画**金色描边 + 底部操作提示条**（「轻点跳转 · 拖动平移 · 再点收起」），避免玩家不知道怎么退出
- 站在传送阵上点小地图时，依旧优先进入传送模式（原逻辑不变）

## 2. 战场弹出数字美化

`scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`（主机）+ `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`（客户端）同步改：

**伤害数字**
- 三种配色区分：物理=暖橙、法术=品紫、暴击=亮金（描边跟着换深色，暴击用深棕描边避免糊成一圈）
- 加**柔和投影**（数值从杂乱战场背景里托出来）+ 描边随字号缩放（16→60px 都有合适粗细）
- 新增**弹入动画**：数字先放大 1.45 倍再 `TRANS_BACK` 回弹到 1.0（暴击弹得更狠、上浮更高），之后立方缓出上浮 + 淡出；暴击四芒星图标位置改为按实际数字高度精确居中

**金币弹出**：原来的 `KillGoldPopup` 升级为通用 `ValuePopup`——左侧矢量徽标 + 数值，自己击杀=**金色小剑 + 34 号字**，助攻/自然金币=**金币徽标（金环+亮面+高光弧）+ 30 号字**，同样带弹入 + 上浮淡出（客户端补了 `_CoinMark`，两端一致）

**治疗数字**：纯绿字改为**绿色十字徽标 + 数值**，和伤害数字一眼区分，弹入/上浮更快更轻

## 验证

- 战斗内实际调用 5 种弹出（普通/暴击伤害、金币 2 种、治疗）：尺寸正常（26×30 / 95×73 / 181×55 / 196×62 / 113×48），无脚本错误
- SubViewport 离屏渲染 + 逐像素统计：金币金像素 621、小剑金色 153、治疗绿色 396、文字亮色 1168 → 三种徽标都真实画出来了
- 小地图：模拟轻点 → `zoomed=true, scale=(2,2), 居中`；再点 → `zoomed=false, scale/位置精确还原 + 触发跳转`；主机与客户端两条路径都通过
- 大厅、联机客户端场景、单机战斗 headless + 窗口渲染冒烟均无 `SCRIPT ERROR`

改动文件：`scripts/ui/MiniMap.gd`、`scripts/net/NetMiniMap.gd`、`scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`、`scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`（未提交 git、未打包）。

func flat(alpha: float = 0.92, radius: int = 12, border: int = 1,
		edge: Color = C_PANEL_EDGE, bg: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
		pad: float = 10.0, shadow: float = 0.0) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	var base := C_PANEL_BG
	base.a = alpha
	sb.bg_color = base if bg.a <= 0.0 else bg
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	sb.set_corner_detail(8)
	sb.set_border_width_all(border)
	sb.border_color = edge
	sb.border_blend = true
	sb.content_margin_left = pad
	sb.content_margin_right = pad
	sb.content_margin_top = pad * 0.6
	sb.content_margin_bottom = pad * 0.6
	if shadow > 0.0:
		sb.shadow_size = int(shadow)
		sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	return sb


## 卡片：品级/角色色描边；选中态加亮 + 同色外发光。
func skin_card(accent: Color, selected: bool = false, alpha: float = 0.92) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var edge := accent if selected else Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.32)
	var sb := flat(alpha, 10, 2 if selected else 1, edge)
	if selected:
		sb.bg_color = sb.bg_color.lightened(0.06)
		sb.shadow_size = 6
		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.22)

func ui_scale() -> float:

func _apply_label_style(label: Label, font_size: int = 14, color: Color = UiKit.C_TEXT):

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable binary: `C:\Users\18749\AppData\Local\Temp\godot47.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe`; GDScript only; no test suite; renderer `mobile` (Vulkan); viewport design 2400×1400, stretch `canvas_items`/`expand`.

- `class_name` globals need refreshed cache: run `& $g --headless --path . --import` after adding new `class_name` files.
- Pixel verification pattern used: `SubViewport.new()` with `size`, `render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS`, `get_texture().get_image()`, `img.save_png("res://.tmp/shot/...")`, then count pixels via GDScript `img.get_pixel()` (avoids Python/OCR).
- HUD layout constants (host `UI_Manager._create_info_labels()`): `CENTER_X = 0.5`; `team_stats_bg` offsets `-145..315` (x), `6..150` (y) — already shifted right 100px previously ("Request B 微调：中央带整体右移 100px (-240/240 → -140/340)"); `time_chip`/`game_time_label` `-140..110, 8..52`; `kda_label` `-120..300, 12..48` (right-aligned); `team_stats_label` `-135..300, 82..142`; `gold_chip` anchored right `-286..-40, 8..62`; `rec_card` `-470..-116, 70..190`; `buy_plus_btn` `-108..-12, 79..181`; `respawn_container` (hero circular avatars, VBox, 2 rows) at `position = Vector2(500 + UiKit.safe_left(), 28 + UiKit.safe_top())`, separation 6, cell ~130×150, ring r≈56.25 — **overlaps team_stats_bg right edge (315) since avatars start at x=500 but panel right edge is CENTER+315 = 1515 in 2400-wide design; overlap likely when CENTER=1200 → 1200+315=1515 vs avatar at 500 → no overlap in design space; must re-check actual conflict**.
- Host minimap: `BattleManager` creates `Minimap.new()`, `MINIMAP_SIZE = 450`, `size = Vector2(450,450)`, offsets `40 + safe_left/safe_top` (no CanvasLayer; drawn under `UI_Manager` CanvasLayer). `_draw_frame()` draws base plate & border at `Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(MINIMAP_SIZE, MINIMAP_SIZE))` with comment "边框与地图同界：不再向外扩 2px，避免深色底板相对地图/左上角看起来整体错位" — the recurring "底板错位" issue relates to this.

  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

The comment at MiniMap.gd:372 confirms: "避免深色底板相对地图/左上角看起来整体错位" — the dark base plate vs map/corner.

So the user's complaint = the dark plate looks offset relative to the map content (probably at corners since the plate has rounded corners while the map is square). Fix options:
1. Draw the terrain/content clipped to the rounded rect — hard without shader.
2. Draw the frame with the same rounded corners but also draw a "corner mask": for each corner, draw a dark quarter-shape covering the terrain outside the rounded corner (i.e., fill the corner notch with the panel background color). That effectively makes the content appear rounded.
3. Draw the dark plate (opaque fill) *behind* the content with rounded corners and then also fill the corner notches with the same opaque color drawn *after* the content: i.e., draw 4 corner "bites" filled with the HUD-side color (transparent can't erase, so must paint with whatever is behind — impossible over a live 3D scene since the minimap sits over the 3D world).

Hmm, the minimap is drawn over the 3D world; a rounded-corner plate would show the world through the corner notch — which is actually the desired "rounded panel" look. Currently: the content is square, so the plate's rounded corner makes content poke out (and no plate/background behind to hide the notch). The *plate ring* is dark 2px but fill transparent — so at corners you see: terrain square corners + ring arcs cutting in → looks like the ring is offset inward at corners.

Best fix: draw the base plate as an **opaque rounded rect** behind the content (bg alpha high), then draw content over it — but content (square) would still cover the corners, poking outside the rounded plate. So also need to clip content.

Alternative fix: use a **SubViewport** for the map and a rounded mask? heavy.

Alternative simple fix: draw the map content with a *corner clip* by drawing the terrain into an Image-based texture with rounded alpha mask once (static), but dynamic content (heroes/turrets/fog) still square.

Alternative pragmatic fix: keep square corners for the frame (radius 0) so plate ring is flush with content everywhere → no corner mismatch. Slight aesthetic change but "错位" gone. Hmm, but the user liked rounded corners probably.

Better alternative: draw the 4 corner notches **after** content using `draw_rect` with... can't erase. But we CAN draw the corner notch filled with the *scene* behind? No.

Hmm, but actually maybe simply drawing the plate ring with `corner_radius` but ALSO drawing the content *inset* by 1-2px so it never pokes outside the ring? The mismatch is at corners where the arc cuts ~3.5px inside (for r=12, the arc is tangent at the edges): the terrain corner extends into the notch area up to ~3.5px beyond the arc. If we inset the content by ~3.5px, the content wouldn't reach the edges (gap at edges) — bad.

Wait, is the current visual actually bad? The ring arcs at corners cut across the terrain corner, so the terrain's square corner sits *outside* the ring's arc but *inside* the bounding square — meaning dark terrain corner pixels appear outside a light-ish arc → looks like a stray square corner. Slightly ugly but subtle.

Hmm, but the user says "位置似乎又错位了" = position seems misaligned *again*. Maybe they perceive the whole minimap plate (dark ring) as offset relative to the *map content*: e.g., the ring appears 1-2px off center. With 450 size and 12 radius, hmm.

Let me look at the actual rendering of a corner: extract a 40x40 pixel patch around the top-left corner of the minimap from hud3.png and print an ASCII with 1 char per pixel, color-coded by hue/brightness. That will show me exactly what the corner looks like: whether the ring is visible, terrain poke, etc. Then decide the fix.

Let me do that: patch at (40,40) 30x30 canvas = image 1:1 (2400x1400 window). Save a zoomed crop as PNG (x8 scale) too for the user to see? I can't view, but the user could. But let me analyze via ASCII.

Let me print for y 38..54, x 38..54: chars by brightness, marking: 'D' if dark (<0.08), 'L' if light bluish (b > r+0.05 and lum>0.3), 't' terrain, etc.

Actually better: I'll crop 4 corners × 24px and print with 2 chars per pixel? Let me just print single chars, 24 rows × 24 cols per corner = manageable.

Let me write a script that renders and dumps a text grid for the top-left corner (and maybe bottom-right) plus the exact pixel rows.

Actually, I could compute programmatically: for each corner, check the 4 pixels at (40,40), (41,41), etc. — the ring arc. The question is whether any terrain pixel lies outside the arc but inside the square. That's guaranteed by geometry (r=12 rounded corners cut the square). So the "错位" is inherent to the rounded style.

Hmm, so what would the fix be? Option: give the minimap a **dark opaque rounded base plate drawn behind the content, then draw the content inset by the corner radius region**? no.

Practical approach used by moba games: the minimap content is clipped to a rounded rect via a shader/mask. Godot: `CanvasGroup` + `clip_children`? In Godot 4, `CanvasItem.clip_children = CLIP_CHILDREN_ONLY` clips *children* to the item's shape (its drawn content as a mask). So: if I create a child Control that draws the rounded rect mask... Actually `clip_children = CLIP_CHILDREN_ONLY` makes the parent's own drawing act as a mask for children. So: parent Control draws nothing (mask off) ... hmm the parent must draw the rounded rect as mask; children (map drawing) get clipped to it. But our map is drawn in `_draw` of the Minimap itself, not children.

Could restructure: Minimap draws only a rounded-rect (as mask) then a child Control draws the content? That's a big refactor.

Alternative: draw the corners' notches after content with an opaque color equal to the *background* behind the minimap — but that's the 3D world (variable). Could instead use a **solid dark plate**: draw the base plate as an opaque rounded rect *behind* content (so corners show plate edge... no, content covers).

Hmm hold on: if the plate is *opaque* and drawn behind, and content is drawn over it, the content's square corners still cover the rounded plate corners — so you'd see terrain in the notch, same issue. Unless we inset the content by 0? no.

OK alternative: accept corners and instead **round the frame the other way**: draw the frame ring *inside* the square with a radius, but also draw a *dark opaque square-corner* under it so the corner region outside the arc is dark plate rather than map content. That is: draw, behind the map content, an opaque dark rounded rect that is 4px larger than the map rect (grow 4) so that the plate's rounded corner arcs sit outside the map's square corners. Then the map's square corners are covered...? No: the plate behind doesn't cover the map content (map drawn on top).

Unless the map content is drawn *smaller* than the plate: plate rect grows by 4 → 458; map content at 0..450. Then the plate's rounded corners at its corners are outside the map corners? No—plate corners around the map corners: the plate's corner arc is 4px outside; the map's square corner is inside the plate region... but the map corner still covers the plate area inside the plate's corner. So the visible corner = map corner (square), and outside the map edge (the 4px band of plate) is dark plate → the plate looks like a dark border frame with square inner corners and rounded outer corners. That's actually a common look and no "错位". Hmm! But that's what the PREVIOUS fix reverted ("不再向外扩 2px") — user complained the plate looked offset when expanded. So they want the plate flush with the map.

So user wants: plate ring exactly at map edge (flush), with the map content appearing rounded at corners? Impossible without clipping. But maybe what they actually want is: the dark plate exactly matching the map's square bounds — i.e., **square corners** (radius 0) — so nothing looks offset. Then the plate is a plain square frame around the map. Given the map content is square (it's a full map), square corners are the only perfectly flush option.

So the fix: set frame corner radius to 0 for the minimap frame (both host & client), so the dark plate ring hugs the map exactly with no corner notch → no perceived misalignment. Maybe also the zoom hint rect. That's a minimal, defensible fix.

Hmm, but is the user seeing the *corner* mismatch or something else? The comment history mentions "深色底板相对地图/左上角看起来整体错位" — "整体" (as a whole) → the plate appeared *shifted as a whole* relative to the map/upper-left corner. That was when the plate was expanded by 2px (grow), making it stick out on all sides → looks shifted. The fix removed the expansion.

Now "又错位了" — as a whole shifted again? What could shift the plate as a whole? If the *content* is drawn at a different size than the plate: e.g., terrain drawn at 0..450 but plate drawn at 0..448 or with a 1px offset. In our pixel scan: dark border at exactly x=40 and 489, light at 41 and 488 — symmetric ✓. Vertically same ✓. So no shift... at 1:1 scale.

BUT at the device's fractional scale (e.g., 0.771 or 1.296), 1px lines land on fractional pixels → antialiasing/misalignment could make the plate look off by a pixel relative to content — especially the **light 1px inner ring** blended. Eh.

Hmm, wait. Maybe the *content* isn't square-corner problem but rather the map content is drawn with `draw_texture_rect` at 450 while the *static overlay* and fog use `MINIMAP_SIZE` ✓.

OK here's another thought experiment: What if the user means the minimap *scroll/pan*: the "底板" = the *view rectangle* (取景框, the white frame showing camera view)? No, they'd say 取景框.

I'll go with the corner-radius hypothesis and *also* ask? Hmm, asking without options is weak.

Actually, let me reconsider one more time by looking at the *device* rendering: the device canvas is likely ~3111x1400 (wide). Wait, if the canvas is wider than the design, the *minimap* stays at 40..490 while the *HUD safe area* etc. — but the **top band** is center-anchored → sits at 1555..2015. And the user's overlap complaint (avatars vs band) can't happen... unless the canvas is 2400 wide.

Could the canvas be 2400 wide on a 2400x1080 phone? With `expand` aspect in Godot 4: stretch_scale = min(win/base). For win 2400x1080, base 2400x1400: min(1.0, 0.771) = 0.771 → viewport size = win/scale = 3111x1400. So canvas width 3111. So no overlap. But user reports overlap → contradiction → so maybe their window is 2400x1400-ish (desktop testing with `--resolution`?) or the phone resolution isn't 1080x2400.

Hmm, what if the phone screen is 1080x2400 **portrait** and the game runs portrait? Then canvas = 2400 x 5333 (huge vertical). The top band would be at y=6..150 from top, avatars at y=28, minimap at 40 — all at the top, and the width 2400 → overlap happens ✓✓! And the minimap at 40..490 top-left, avatars 500..1190, band 1055..1515 → overlap ✓. But a portrait MOBA is weird... unless the game locks orientation? Hmm, if the game is portrait, the HUD would look odd but the top band at y=6..150 still fits.

func _styl(lab: Label, font_size: int, col: Color) -> void:
	# 同主机 _apply_label_style：字号 × ui_scale()，描边色/宽度也随字号缩放
	lab.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(round(font_size * ui_scale())))
	lab.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	lab.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.82))
	lab.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", UiKit.outline_size(font_size * ui_scale()))

func _build() -> void:
	var rs := ui_scale()
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

	_panel = Panel.new()
	# 同主机：属性标题条占住小地图正下方后，目标框下移到 属性顶边 + 标题条高 + 12；刘海/挖孔避让
	_panel.position = Vector2(40 + UiKit.safe_left(), 350 + UiKit.safe_top() + 30.0 * rs + 12.0)
	_panel.size = Vector2(330 * rs, 170 * rs)
	# 同主机：深色玻璃 + 2px 冷光描边 + 16px 柔和投影 + 大圆角
	var frame := UiKit.flat(0.94, 12, 2, Color(0.62, 0.74, 0.96, 0.22), Color(0.025, 0.045, 0.095, 0.92), 0.0, 16.0)
	frame.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
	frame.set_corner_detail(10)
	_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", frame)
	_panel.visible = false
	add_child(_panel)

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。

- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

仔细核对后，找到真正错位的那块底板：**小地图正下方的属性标题底板宽度还停在小地图原来 300 宽的时候**。

**核对过程（排除法）**
- 边框本身没有偏移：1:1 渲染逐像素分类，四边都是「外 1px 深色环 + 内 1px 高光线」（左/上 40、41，右/下 489、488），四个角的金色 L 角标（3px 粗×16px 长）与圆角弧线位置一致，地图内容和底板同界。
- 但小地图从 300 放大到 450 后，**下面的属性标题条（收起态底板）宽度仍是写死的 300**（`_layout_attribute_panel` 里 `300.0`），左对齐后右缘停在 340，比小地图右缘 490 短了 150px——常驻可见，所以看着就是“小地图底板错位”。联机客户端同处写的是 `minf(panel_w, 300*s)`，在手机上反而是 525，比小地图还宽。

**改动**
- [UI_Manager.gd](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd:2940)：收起态底板宽 `300.0 → 450.0`，与小地图同宽、顶边仍是 500（小地图 490 + 10）。
- [NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd:4168)：`minf(panel_w, 300.0*s) → 450.0`，与主机、小地图一致（点击热区 `_attr_head_rect` 同步）。

**验证**
- 布局探针：`MM_RECT=(40,40,450,450)`、`ATTR_RECT=(40,500,450,44.5)` → 左缘/右缘完全对齐；
- 渲染像素扫描（y=522）：底板左边缘在 x=40、右边缘在 x=489/490，与小地图右缘一致；
- `battle.tscn` / `net_client.tscn` / 大厅 headless 各跑 90–120 帧，无 SCRIPT ERROR。

若你说的“底板”是另外一块（比如角标、圆角观感），发一张小地图区域的截图，我按图改。

from PIL import Image

import numpy as np

src = r"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\我的截图\小地图底板错位.png"

# 行/列扫描：深色占比
for y in [480, 485, 488, 490, 492, 500, 700, 900, 930, 935, 940, 945, 950]:

    idx = np.nonzero(row)[0]
    print(f"y={y} dark x range", (idx.min() + 400, idx.max() + 400, idx.size) if idx.size else None)
for x in [480, 485, 488, 490, 492, 500, 700, 930, 935, 940, 945]:

mm = can[40:490, 40:490]
ghost = can[490:940, 490:940]
def blocks(img, n=15):

    bh, bw = h // n, w // n
    out = np.zeros((n, n, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            out[i, j] = img[i*bh:(i+1)*bh, j*bw:(j+1)*bw].reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0)
    return out
b1, b2 = blocks(mm), blocks(ghost)
print("minimap block mean", b1.mean(axis=(0, 1)))
print("ghost   block mean", b2.mean(axis=(0, 1)))
c = np.corrcoef(b1.reshape(-1), b2.reshape(-1))[0, 1]
print("corr(minimap, ghost) =", round(float(c), 3))
for name, img in [("mm", b1), ("ghost", b2)]:
    print(name, "grid:")
    for i in range(15):
        print("   " + " ".join(f"{v:5.0f}" for v in img[i, :, 1]))

{"content":"from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

src = r"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\我的截图\小地图底板错位.png"
im = Image.open(src).convert("RGB")
a = np.asarray(im).astype(np.int16)
OX, OY = 15, 141
can = a[OY:OY + 1400, OX:OX + 2400]
r, g, b = can[..., 0], can[..., 1], can[..., 2]
gold = (r > 150) & (g > 110) & (b < 110) & (r > b + 80) & (g > b + 50)
ys, xs = np.nonzero(gold)
print("gold total", xs.size, "bbox", xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())

outside = (xs > 495) | (ys > 495)
print("gold outside minimap:", int(outside.sum()))
xo, yo = xs[outside], ys[outside]

    # 直方图：按 20px 分桶，找密集行列
    import collections
    hx = collections.Counter((xo // 20 * 20).tolist())
    hy = collections.Counter((yo // 20 * 20).tolist())
    print("top x buckets:", sorted(hx.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:12])
    print("top y buckets:", sorted(hy.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:12])
    # 抽样点
    idx = np.linspace(0, xo.size - 1, min(25, xo.size)).astype(int)
    print("samples:", [(int(xo[i]), int(yo[i])) for i in idx])
","file_path":".tmp\gold_probe.py"}

Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. tools.description: Wait for the next teammate status, message, or shared-task change after this call starts. This never wakes inactive members and returns noProgress immediately when no other member is running or provisioning. Re-list after wakeup or timeout instead of polling.

timeout_ms.description: Wait duration in milliseconds, from 10000 through 3600000. Defaults to 30000.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: 1–4 search queries; their results are merged.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

    pad = k // 2

    y = y - y.mean()
